hymns.title: Oh, worship the King, all glorious above.
verses: 1. Oh, worship the King, all glorious above.
Oh, gratefully sing his power and his love;
Our shield and defender, the Ancient of Days,
Pavilioned in splendor and girded with praise.
2. Oh, tell of his might; oh, sing of his grace,
Whose robe is the light, whose canopy space;
His chariots of wrath the deep thunderclouds form,
And dark is his path on the wings of the storm.
3. The earth with its store of wonders untold,
Almighty, your power has founded of old,
Established it fast by a changeless decree,
And round it has cast, like a mantle, the sea.
4. Your bountiful care what tongue can recite?
It breathes in the air, it shines in the light,
It streams from the hills, it descends to the plain
And sweetly distills in the dew and the rain.
5. Frail children of dust, and feeble as frail,
In you do we trust, nor find you to fail;
Your mercies, how tender, how firm to the end,
Our maker, defender, redeemer, and friend!
While angels delight to hymn you above.
The humbler creation, though feeble their lays,
With true adoration shall sing to your praise.

6.Oluwa ti so ohun gbogbo di otun
Ko s'iku, ko si ofo mo,
O dara, O dara f'okan mi .

hymns.title: I was glad, and rejoiced to see my Messiah
verses: 1.I was glad, and rejoiced to see my Messiah
And joy filled my heart very much
O come, please do come, all good people who seek good
Lift your eyes, look upon the glorious King
It is well, it is well
With my soul, with my soul
2. Christ King has returned with his amazing glory
Sorrow has gone and Joy has come
Turns my self-pity into dance and rejoicing
I give thanks, I give thanks to the Lord
I give thanks, I give thanks
To the Lord, to the Lord
3. Thousands of my tongues are not enough to praise you
Father, for your grace towards me
O Father of all favour and abiding grace
We bow down, we bow down unto Him
We bow down, we bow down
4.Your joy and glory abounds in Jerusalem
Where your just ones are rejoicing
I have seen the Messiah, He’s the glorious King
It is well, it is well, with my soul
It is well, it is well
With my soul, with my soul
5.Do not be afraid, all you righteous holy ones
Our Master and Lord has won
He has made for us, a bright victorious crown
It is well, it is well, with my soul
It is well, it is well
With my soul, with my soul
6. The Lord God has renewed and made all things as new
There’s no more death, and no more pain
My sorrow has ended for God has overcome
It is well, it is well with my soul
It is well, it is well
With my soul, with my soul

hymns.title: E gbo b'iro ipe na ti ndun to
verses: 1.E gbo b'iro ipe na ti ndun to
E yara wa, e ma daraduro
2.E gbo b'iro Ipe naa ti ndun to
E ba Mi kalo s'Ori ite Ogo
3.E gbo b'iro ipe naa ti ndun to
4.E gbo b'iro ipe na ti ndun to
E yara wa e ma daraduro
5.Egbo b'iro ipe naa ti ndun to
E ba mi kalo s'Ori ite Ogo
6.E gbo b'iro ipe naa ti ndun to
E wa sibi simi Ogo mi naa
7.E gbo b'iro orun naa ti ndun to
E wa, e wa, fun 'simi okan yin
chorus: E wa je ipe mimo naa eyin mimo
E wa kalo wo oba Ogo naa

hymns.title: Do you hear how loud the resounding call is
verses: 1.Do you hear how loud the resounding call is
So make haste, come and don’t delay further
The love of Christ calls you
2.Do you hear how loud the resounding call is
And come with me towards the glorious throne
3.Do you hear how loud the resounding call is
Get ready, come, ‘cause sluggishness won’t help
4.Do you hear how loud the resounding call is
Make haste and come, don’t get yourself held up
5.Do you hear how loud the resounding call is
And come with me towards the glorious throne
6. Do you hear how loud the resounding call is
Come along to my glorious resting place
7.Do you hear how loud heaven’s echo is
O come and get long comfort for your souls
chorus: Come and accept the holy call, o Sanctified
Come join us as we go to look on Him
O you who wait on Him

hymns.title: Fun ewa didan aye
verses: Fun adun to yi wa ka
Ti o fi fun iran wa

hymns.title: For the beauty of the earth
verses: Since early days of our youth
At all times, both day and night
Of the earth and juicy fruits
Sun and Moon with all the stars
3.For the gift of sound and sight
For the power of living soul
Pulling all our being as one
Friends on earth and up above
For all good and rightful thoughts
He has given to our race
And for all His wholesome grace
In this life and one to come
chorus: Unto you we lift our song

hymns.title: N'nu gbogbo ayida aye
verses: Sa je, ki 'sin Re j'ayo yin
Oun yio ma toju yin.       Amin

hymns.title: Through all the changing scenes
verses: 1.Through all the changing scenes of life
The praises of my God shall still
When in distress to Him l call'd
4.Oh make but trial of His love,
How blest they are, and only they,
5.Fear Him ye saints; and you will then
Make you His service your delight,
Your wants shall be His care.   Amen.

hymns.title: O fun mi l'edidi
verses: B'o ti fun mi, O si rerin
B'O ti fun mi, O si rerin
O nso ife, eni to san
Eri ife re si mi ni;

hymns.title: He gave to me a seal
verses: Of the great debt I owe
And as He gave, He smiled and said
All of my debts He paid,
And as He gave, He smiled and said
Though, the debt is all paid
The seal told of the love of One
Who paid the debt for me,
The earnest of His love for me.
That all the debt of sin was paid

hymns.title: Ji, okan mi, dide layo
verses: O yo mi ninu osi mi
O nmu mi la gbogbo re ja
T'o su dudu t'o nsan ara
O duro ti mi laarin re
Sugbon bi mo ti ngbagbe Re
7.Nje ki nfo lo, ki nsi goke

hymns.title: Awake, my soul, to joyful lays
verses: And sing thy great Redeemer's praise,
He justly claims a song from me,
His loving kindness, oh, how free!
2. He saw me ruined by the fall
He sav'd me from my lost estate,
His loving kindness, oh, how great!
Tho' earth and hell my way oppose,
He safely leads my soul along
His loving kindness, oh, how strong!
Has gather'd thick and thunder'd loud,
He near my soul has always stood,
His loving kindness, oh how good!
Prone from my Jesus to depart,
And though I oft have Him forgot,
6. I will soon depart from this world
I want to be free from this flesh
Ah!  Let my lasting soul sing out
His loving kindness, till we die
7. Let me fly away, and mount up
And with wonderful joy sing out
His loving kindness, is heaven.  Amen.

hymns.title: Jesu o d'agutan,
verses: K'a le r'ibugbe wa n'nu re,

hymns.title: Jesus the Lamb of God
verses: You who shed your own blood
To save us all from destruction
You who beared our heavy burden
3. Friend of those who are lost
To pay off the debts of our souls
And make our sins His own
To your side do we come
That we may find our home in You

hymns.title: Oluwa mi mo njade lo,
verses: Ki nroju Re ni ise mi
K'emi si le fife Re han
K'o pa okan mi mo kuro
Ma wa lowo tun mi titi
Ki nma sise, lo l'ase Re
Ki nfi se, mi gbogbo fun O
Ki nma foju sin nnkan t'orun
Je ki nle lo fun ogo Re,
Ki nba O rin titi d'orun.  Amin

hymns.title: Forth in Thy name, O Lord I go,
verses: 1.Forth in Thy name, O Lord I go,
Thee, only Thee, resolved to know
In all I think, or speak, or do.
In all my work  Thy presence find,
And hide my simple heart above,
Above the thorns of chocking care
The gilded baits of worldly love.
4.Thee may I set at my right hand,
Whose eyes my inmost substance see
And offer all my work to Thee,
5.Give me to bear Thy easy yoke,
And every moment watch and pray,
And still to thing? eternal look,
And hasten to Thy glorious day.
Whate'er Thy bounteous grace hath giv'n,
And run my course with even joy
And closely walk with Thee to heaven.

hymns.title: Wa s'adura ooro
verses: Mo sun, sugbon okan mi ji

hymns.title: Come to the morning pray'r,
verses: Come, let us kneel and pray;
Pray’r is the Christian pilgrim’s staff
To walk with God all day.
Sweet is the shadow from the heat,
When the sun smites by the day.
And finding there the house of God,
At heav'n's gate close the day.
I sleep, but my heart waketh, Lord
With Thee to watch and pray.

hymns.title: Baba mi gbo temi
verses: Fa mi, ko si gba mi.

hymns.title: Holy Father, hear me;
verses: Move me, draw me, win me.

hymns.title: Imole ooro didun yi
verses: So mi di mimo laye yi

hymns.title: The Morning bright with rosy light
verses: 1. The Morning bright with rosy light
Has waked me from my sleep;
Father, I own Thy love alone
2.All through the day, I humbly pray,
Be Thou my guard and guide;
My sins forgive, and let me live,
3.Oh make Thy rest within my breast,
Make me like Thee, then shall I be
Prepared to see Thy face.   Amen.

hymns.title: Ninu gbogbo ewu oru
verses: Titi a o foju wa ri

hymns.title: Through all the dangers of the night
verses: 1.Through all the dangers of the night,
The Lord doth keep me safe,
And to bow down the knee
2.Oh Lord we pray keep us today,
Only the ones whom thou doth keep
3.Let all our thoughts and all our deeds,
So that our light may truly shine
And beam to all the world.
4.O grant that we ne'er stray from Thee,
Until our eyes there shall behold
Thy face for ever more.      Amen

hymns.title: Ji okan mi, ba orun ji
verses: K' o san gbese ebo ooro.
Si lo oni bi opin re;
Maa lo ebun re, fun rere;
K'o si mura d'ojo nla ni.
Si f'Emi Re kun inu mi.
Yin Baba, Omo, oun Emi.     Amin

hymns.title: Awake, my soul and with the sun
verses: 1.Awake, my soul and with the sun
Thy daily stage of duty run;
Shake off dull sloth, and joyful rise
Each present day thy last esteem;
Improve thy talent with due care;
For the great day thyself prepare
Thy conscience as the noontide clean;
Think how all seeing God thy ways
And all thy secret thoughts surveys
4.Wake, and lift up thyself, my heart,
And with the angels bear thy part,
Who all night long unwearied sing
High praise to the eternal King
5. Glory to the One that kept me
And comforts me in the heavens
O Lord, raise me up from the dead
6. O Lord, I renew my vows now
That my sins swept off like the rain
Preserve my thoughts and all my care
And fill my heart with Your spirit
7. My thoughts, my words and all my deeds
Take charge of all of them today
So that I can use all my might
Do good deeds for your own glory
8. Praise the Lord, the God of great blessings
Praise Him, You people of this world
Praise Him, You people of heaven
Praise the Father, Son and Spirit.  Amen.

hymns.title: Leekan si bi oorun ti nran
verses: Bee l'O ma bukun ise wa

hymns.title: Once more the sun is beaming bright,
verses: 1.Once more the sun is beaming bright,
Once more to God we pray,
That His eternal light may guide
And cheer our souls this day.
2.O may no sin our hands defile
Or cause our minds to rove,
Upon our lips be simple truth,
And in our hearts be love!
3.Throughout the day, O Christ, in Thee
To save our souls from satan's wiles,
So may our works, in Thee begun,
5.And lest the flesh, profane and proud,
6.To God the Father, God the Son,

hymns.title: Wa sodo mi, Oluwa mi,
verses: Ki 'yonu ma baa se mi mo,
Bi okan mi ba nsako lo,
Ki nle n'ibugbe lodo Re.    Amin

hymns.title: Come to me, Lord, when first I wake,
verses: 1.Come to me, Lord, when first I wake,
As the faint lights of morning break;
Bid purest thoughts within me rise
Like crystal dew-drops to the skies
2.Come to me in the sultory noon;
Or earth's low communings will soon
Of Thy dear face, eclipse the light,
And change my fairest day to night
3.Come to me in the evening shade,
And if my head from Thee hath-
Oh bring it back, and from afar
Smite on me like Thine ev'ning star
4.Come to me in the midnight hour,
When sleep witholds its balmy pow'r
Let my lone spirit find her rest,
Like John, upon my Saviour's breast,
5.Come to me through life's varied way,
And when its pulses cease to play.
Then, Saviour, bid me come to Thee,
That where Thou art. Thy child may be.

hymns.title: Wa ba mi gbe!   ale fere le tan
verses: 1.Wa ba mi gbe! ale fere le tan
Okunkun nsu, Oluwa ba mi gbe
2. Ojo aye mi nsare lo s'opin
Ayo aye nku, ogo re nwo mi
'Wo ti ki yipada wa ba mi gbe
Sugbon ki o ma bo b'oninure
Ki o si ma kaanu fun egbe mi
Wa, ore elese, waba mi gbe.
4.Mo fe O ri, ni wakati gbogbo
Kilo le segun esu b'ore Re?
Tal' o le se amona mi bi Re?
Ibi ko wuwo, ekun ko koro
Ngo segun sibe, b'lwo ba mi gbe.
6.Wa ba mi gbe ni ojo ikehin
Se mole mi si toka si orun
B'aye ti nkoja, kile orun mo
Ni yiye, n'nu Kristi, wa ba mi gbe.    Amin

hymns.title: Abide with me, fast falls the eventide;
verses: 1.Abide with me, fast falls the eventide;
The darkness deepens, Lord, with me abide,
When  other helpers fail, and comforts flee,
Help of the helpless, O abide with me.
2. Swift to its close ebbs out life's little day,
Earth's joy grow dim, its glories pass away,
Change and decay in all around I see
O Thou who changest not, abide with me!
3.Come not in terrors, as the King of kings
But kind and good, with healing in
Tears for all woes, a heart for every plea.
Come Friend of sinners, thus abide with me.
4.I need Thy presence every passing hour;
What but Thy grace can foil the tempter's   pow'r?
Who like Thyself my guide and stay can be?
Through cloud and sunshine, O abide with me.
5.I fear no foe, with Thee at hand to bless;
Ills have no weight, and tears no
Where is death's sting? Where grave, thy victory?
I triumph still, if thou abide with me
6.Hold Thou Thy Cross before my closing eyes;
Shine through the gloom, add point me to the skies;
earths vain shadows O Lord, abide with me!Amen.

hymns.title: Ife Re, da wa si loni
verses: Pa wa mo n'nu ewu gbogbo
L'apa Re, ni k'a sun si
Je k'a simi lodo Re.   Amin.

hymns.title: Thy love has spared our lives today,
verses: 1.Thy love has spared our lives today,
Though we lay-down, spent and worn,
Guard us in the stillness of night,
Us no pow'rs of darkness harm;
It is sweet to trust in Thee.
Dwelling in the midst of foes;
Keep us and dear ones from danger,
On thy wings in comfort sleep;
And when life's distress is over,
May our souls repose in Thee.  Amen.

hymns.title: Loju ale, 'gbat' orun wo,
verses: Bi a ko tile le ri O,
Awa mo pe O nbe nihin.
Opo ko ni'fe si O to,
Sibe won ko fi O s'Ore.
K'a si le bo lowo ese;
Awon ti si nf'ooto sin O
Oro Re kan ki o gbofo;
Li aanu, wo gbogbo wa san.   Amin.

hymns.title: At even, ere the sun was set,
verses: 1.At even, ere the sun was set,
The sick, O Lord, around Thee lay;
O in what divers pains they met!
O with what joy they went away!
Oppress'd with various ills, draw near;
What if Thy form we cannot see?
We know and feel that Thou art here.
For some are sick, and some are sad,
And some have never lov'd Thee well,
And some have lost the love they had
4. And some have found that world is vain,
Yet from the world they break not free;
And some have friends who give them pain,
Yet have not sought a friend in Thee,
5.And all, O Lord, crave perfect rest
And to be wholly free from sin;
And they who fab would serve Thee best
Are conscious most of wrong within.
6.O Saviour Christ, Thou too art Man,
Thou hast been troubled, tempted, tried;
Thy kind but searching glance can scan
The very wounds that shame would hide;
7.Thy touch has still its ancient pow'r
No word from Thee can fruitless fall.
Hear in this solemn evening hour,
And in Thy mercy heal us all.

hymns.title: K'a to sun, Olugbala wa,
verses: A jewo ese wa fun O,
Iwo l’o le gba wa la;
Ookun ko le se wa mo;
4. Sugbon b'iku ba ji wa pa,

hymns.title: Father, breathe an evening blessing,
verses: Sin and want we come confessing
Thou canst save, and Thou canst heal.
Though the arrow past us fly,
We are safe, if Thou art nigh.
3.Though the night be dark and dreary,
Thou art He, who never weary
4. But if death should snatch us away
And our bed turn into grave
Let the fresh'ning morn awake us

hymns.title: Jesu, bukun wa k'a to lo!
verses: 1. Jesu, bukun wa k'a to lo!
Gbin oro re, si aya wa,
K'a ba le jo O l'ajotan;
Ma je k'a gbo t'ara nikan
Je ki aanu Re mu wa yo,
A tun f'ojo kan sunmo O

hymns.title: O Saviour, bless us ere we go
verses: 1.O Saviour, bless us ere we go,
Thy word into our minds instill,
And make our likewarm hearts to glow
With lowly love and fervent will,
Through life's long day and death's dark night
O gentle Jesus, be our light.
2.The day is gone, its hours have run;
And Thou hast taken count of all,
The scanty triumphs grace hath won,
The broken vow, the frequent fall,
3.Forgive us, Lord; yea, give us joy,
That only long to be like Thee,
4. Labour is sweet, for Thou has toil’d,
And care is light, for Thou hast cared:
Let not our work with self be soil'd
5.For all we love, the poor, the sad,
The sinful, unto Thee we call;
Oh let Thy mercy make us glad;
Thou art our Saviour, and our all.
6.O Saviour, bless us; night is come,
Thy holy Presence with us be,
Good angels watch about our home,
And we are one day nearer Thee.

hymns.title: Ero di/dun kan/nso
verses: Ju bi / mo ti sunmo ri.
Ti a o la ko/ja dandan
Je ki nmo p'o/ sunmo mi
O le je, pe mo / nsunmole
Sunmo / ju bi mo ti ro Amin.

hymns.title: A sweet thought rises up
verses: I am closer to my home
2. I draw near the great truth
I draw near the crystal sea
Where there are many mansions there
3. I draw near the end of life
When we all lay down the cross
And we lift up our crowns
4. At this very great cross road
That we will surely cross over
And do make my faith stronger
Let me know you are close to me
At the edge of sure death
6. Let me know that you’re close
When I fall into the pit
It may be that I’m close to home
Nearer than I ever thought. Amen.

hymns.title: Oluwa, ojo t'o fun wa pin
verses: 2.A dupe ti Ijo Re, ko nsun
O si nsona ni gbogbo aye
4.Oorun to wo fun wa si ti la,
O duro,   o si nse akoso
Tit'eda Re o juba Re.    Amin.

hymns.title: The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended,
verses: 1.The day Thou gavest, Lord, is ended,
The darkness fails at Thy behest;
To Thee our morning hymns ascended,
Thy praise shall sanctify our rest.
While earth rolls onward into light,
Through all the world her watch is
And rests not now by day or night
The dawn leads on another day,
The voice of pray'r is never silent,
Nor dies the strain of praise away.
4.The sun that bids us rest is waking
And hour by hour fresh lips are making
Thy wanderous doings heard on high.
5.So be it, Lord; Thy throne shall never,
Like earth's proud empires, pass away
Thy kingdom stands, and grows for ever
Till all Thy creatures own Thy sway.

hymns.title: 'Wo imole laaarin okun aye
verses: Okunkun su: mo si jina s'ile
To sise mi, ohun ehin ola
Nko ni bere, sise kan to fun mi
2.Nigba kan ri, emi ko be O, pe
Beni nko fe O, sugbon nigbayi
Afe aye ni mo ti nto lehin
3. Ipa Re lo ndi mi mu, yo si
Titi em'o fi ri awon wonni
Ti mo fe, ti won ti faye sile.    Amin.

hymns.title: Lead, kindly Light, amid the Encircling gloom,
verses: 1.Lead, kindly Light, amid the Encircling gloom,
The night is dark, amd I am far from Home;
Keep Thou my feet; I do not ask to see
The distant scene-one step enough for me.
2.I was not ever thus nor pray'd that Thou
I lov'd to choose and  see my path but now
I loved the garish day, and spite of fears,
Pride ruled my will; remember not past years.
3.So long Thy pow'r hath bless'd me,
O'er moor and fen, o'er crag and torrent, till
And with the morn those angel faces smile
Which I have lov'd long since, and lost awhile.      Amen.

hymns.title: Olugbala,a tun fe fohun
verses: Yin oruko re k'a to tu ka lo
Ni' pari 'sin, a dide lati yin
A o si kunle fun ibukun Re
2. F'alafia fun wa ba tin re 'le
Je k'a pari ojo yi pelu re
Pa aiya wa mo siso ete wa
T'a fi pe oruko re nile yii
So Okunkun re d'imole fun wa
Ninu ewu, yo awa omo Re.
Ookun oun 'mole j'okan naa fun o
Rewa l'ekun, k'o si gbewa nija
'Gbat'o ba si fopin si idamu wa
Pe wa, baba, s'orun alafia. Amin

hymns.title: Saviour again to thy dear name we raise
verses: 1. Saviour again to thy dear name we raise
With one accord our parting hymn of praise
We stand to bless thee ere our worship cease
Then lowly kneeling wait thy word of peace
2. Grant us thy peace upon our homeward way
With thee began, with thee shall end the day
Guard thou the lips from sin, the heart from shame
That in this house have called upon thy name
3. Grant us thy peace, Lord through the coming night
Turn thou for us darkness into light
From harm and danger keep thy children free
For dark and night are both alike to thee
4. Grant us thy peace through our earthly life
Our balm is sorrow, and our stay in strife
Then, when thy voice shall bid our conflict cease
Call us, oh Lord, to thine eternal peace. Amen

hymns.title: Holy Father pave our way
verses: With your great sunshine of love
Every night, please give to us
Your great light in the dark night
Fear in us at the night watch
At the end, please give to us
Your great light in the dark night
While facing the threat of death
At that very hour give us
Your great light in the dark night
There is no darkness in You
Those that you protect now have
The great light in the dark night. Amen.

hymns.title: Nigba kan ni Betilehemu
verses: O kere, ko le da nnkan se
O si le ba wa daro
O le ba wa yo peju.
Ba wa n'nu aso ala.      Amin.

hymns.title: Once in royal David's city
verses: Where a mother laid her baby
In a manger for His bed.
2.He came down to earth from heaven
Who is God and Lord of all,
And His shelter was a stable,
And His cradle was a stall,
With the poor, and mean, and lowly
Lived on earth our Saviour holy.
Love, and watch the lowly maiden
In whose gentle arms He lay
Day by day like us He grew;
He was little, weak, and helpless:
Tears and smiles like us He knew
And He feeleth for our sadness,
And He shareth in our gladness.
5.And our eyes at last shall see Him,
For the child so dear and gentle
Is our Lord in heaven above;
And He leads His children on
To the place where He is gone.
We shall see Him; but in Heaven,
Set at God's right hand on high;
When like stars His children crown'd
all in white shall wait around

hymns.title: Wa eyin olooto
verses: Wa kalo, wa kalo si Bethelehem
Ti a bi, t'a ko da;
Ki gbogbo eda orun si gberin
Jesu Iwo li awa nfi ogo fun;
chorus: E wa kalo juba, Kristi Oluwa

hymns.title: O come, all ye faithful,
verses: Come ye, O come ye to
Lo! He abhors, not the Virgin's womb,
Son of the Father, Begotten, not created
Sing, ail ye citizen of heaven above,
Jesus, to Thee be glory given,
chorus: O come let us adore Him,
O come let us adore Him
O come let us adore, He is Christ the Lord

hymns.title: Gbo eda orun nkorin:
verses: O dun mo o k'o b'eniyan gbe
O dun mo o k'o b'eniyan gbe
A bi k'o le tun won bi.
A bi k'o le tun won bi.
Gba wa pada s'ife Re.  Amin.

hymns.title: Hark! the herald-angels sing
verses: Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
Join the triumph of the skies;
Late in time behold Him come,
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see;
Pleas'd as Man with man to dwell,
Pleas'd as Man with man to dwell,
Light and life to-all He brings,
Risen with healing in His wings,
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die,
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.
Fix in us Thy humble home;
Bruise in us the serpent's head,
Stamp Thine image in its place;
Glory to the new-born King. Amen.

hymns.title: Gbat' awon olusaguntan
verses: A fi oja we ara Re

hymns.title: Whilst Shepherds watched their flocks by night,
verses: 1.Whilst Shepherds watched their flocks by night,
The Angel of the Lord came down,
2."Fear not, said he, for mighty dread
Glad tidings of great joy I bring
3. To you in David's town this day
4.The heav'nly Babe you there shall find,
All meanly wrapp't in swaddling bands,
5. Thus spake the Seraph, and forthwith
Of Angels, praising God, and thus
6. "All glory be to God on high,
And to the earth be peace;
Good-will henceforth from Heaven to men

hymns.title: Ayo kun okan wa loni
verses: K'a le ma fi isin mimo

hymns.title: Joy fills our inmost heart to-day;
verses: And angel hosts in glad array
2.Low at the cradle throne we bend,
And feel no bliss can ours transcend,
3.For us the world must lose its charms
When, folded in Thy mother's arms
That we may keep Thy birthday bright,
chorus: Has come on earth to dwell;
No sweeter sound than this is heard

hymns.title: Silent night, holy night,
verses: All is calm, all is bright
Round yon virgin mother and Child.
Holy Infant, so tender and mild,
Son of God, love’s pure light;
Radiant beams from Thy holy face
With the dawn of redeeming grace,
Jesus, Lord, at Thy birth.  Amen.

Nibe lo duro si to ntan

hymns.title: The first Noel the angel did say
verses: 1.  The first Noel the angel did say
Was to certain poor shepherds in fields where they lay;
In fields where they lay, keeping their sheep,
On a cold winter's night that was so deep.
2.They looked up and saw a star,
Shining in the east, beyond them far;
And to the earth, it gave great light,
And so it continued both day and night:
3. This star drew nigh to the northwest;
O'er Bethlehem it took its rest,
And there it did both stop and stay
Right over the place where Jesus lay:
4. And by the light of that same star,
Three wise men came from country far;
To seek for a king was their intent,
And to follow the star wherever it went:
5. Then entered in those wise men three,
And offer'd there, in his presence
Their gold and myrrh and frankincense:
6. Then let us all with one accord
Sing praises to our heav'nly Lord,
That hath made heav'n and earth of naught,
And with his blood mankind hath bought:
chorus: Born is the King of Israel!

hymns.title: Bi awon olus'aguntan
verses: Ihin ayo ni mo mu wa
A fi oja we, a si tee
Fo de, won si nyin Olorun

hymns.title: While shepherds watch'd their
verses: The angel of the Lord came down,
2."Fear not," said he; for mighty dread
"Glad tidings of great joy I bring
3."To you, in David's town, this day
The Saviour, who is Christ the Lord
And this shall be the sign
All meanly wrapp'd in swathing bands,
Of angels, praising God, and thus
6.All glory be to God on high,
And to the earth be peace;
Goodwill henceforth from heav'n to men

hymns.title: Gbo iro orin angeli
verses: 4.A ha mo b'o ti soro to
F' ore-ofe Re ba wa gbe

hymns.title: Hear the chorus of the angels
verses: Saviour is born into the world
To save us from the satan's pow'r
Glory to God in the highest
His throne in heav'n to leave
To drink the cup of agony
5.Let us give praises to our Lord
For His great love to us
He sent th' only begotten Son
6.Thou Son of God that's born today
For the peace of the world
Abide with us Lord, with Thy grace
And the joy of thy birth.    Amen.

hymns.title: Ji 'wo Kristian, Kio ko orin ayo
verses: T'awon Angeli nko n'ijo kinin ni
Lat' odo won n'ihin na ti bere
T'o so f awon Olusaguntan pe
Ta bi fun yin ati gbogbo aye
3.Bi akede Angeli na ti so tan
Won nkorin ayo teti ko gbo ri
Orun si ho fun 'yin Olorun pe
Pelu 'yanu won gbe royin na ka
5.O ye k'awa ko ma ro l'okan wa
Ka si ro tomo na ta bi loni
Ki awa si tele ilana Re
Titi a o fi de 'bugbe l'oke
Ogo enit'a bi fun wa loni
Y'o ma ran yi wa ka titi laelae
A o ma korin ife Re titi

hymns.title: Christians, awake, salute the happy
verses: 1. Christians, awake, salute the happy morn,
Whereon the Saviour of the world was born,
Rise to adore the mystery of love,
Which hosts of angels chanted from above,
With them the joyful tidings first begun
Of God incarnate and the Virgin's Son
2.Then to the watchful shepherd it was told
Who heard the angelic herald voice; Behold,
I bring good tidings of a Saviour's birth
To you and all the nations upon earth;
This day hath God fulfilled His promised word,
This day is born a Saviour,
3.He spake; and straightway the celestial choir
In hymns a joy, unknown before,
The praises of redeeming love they sang,
God's highest glory was their anthem still,
Peace upon earth, and unto men goodwill.
4. So the shepherds went up to Bethlehem
To see the wonder God has done for mankind
They could see Joseph as well as Mary
With the new-born lying in a manger
In wonder they proclaim the news abroad
The news of the arrival of God’s Son.
5.O may we keep and ponder in our mind
God's wondrous love in saving lost
Trace we the Babe, who hath
From the poor manger to the bitter Cross;
Tread in His steps, assisted by His grace,
Till man's first heav'nly stale again takes place.
To sing, redeem'd, a glad triumphal song;
He that was born upon this joyful day
Around us all His glory shall display;
Saved by His love, incessant we shall sing
Eternal praise to heav'ns almighty King.

hymns.title: Wa iwo Jesu ti a nreti
verses: T'a bi lati da ni ide
3.'Wo t'a bi lati gba wa la
Ti a bi lati joba lae
Gbe wa s'ori ite Re.    Amin.

hymns.title: Come, Thou long-expected Jesus.
verses: Born to set Thy people free,
From our fears and sins release us,
Let us find our rest in Thee.
Hope of all the earth Thou art
Born a child and yet a king
Born to reign in us for ever,
Rule in all our hearts alone;
Raise us to Thy glorious throne.

hymns.title: Oluwa nbo: aye o mi
verses: Bi o ti wa n'irele ri;
Eni iya ti o si ku
Ti a se ninu bini si?
B'e wo nu iho, lasan ni;
Y'o korin pe, Oluwa de. Amin.

hymns.title: Our Lord doth come, the world will
verses: 1.Our Lord doth come, the world will quake,
And every moutain shall be moved
And all the siars of heaven too
Shall cease to shine nor give their Light.
When He was slain as Lamb of God,
Our Suff’ring Saviour who has died.
3.Our Lord doth come, doth come in fear,
In flaming fire and in great wrath;
Coming, on Cherub wings doth fly,
Coming, the great Judge of the earth.
4.Is this the one who walked on earth,
Just like a pilgrim on life's road
Is this the one, He that was slain.
Hid in the rocks and in the dens;
But faith that has the victory.
Shall sing at last, “the Lord has come"Amen.

hymns.title: Hark! tis the watchman's cry
verses: Sleep is for sons of night;
Ye are children of the light
Be ye as men that wait
One near Long as  ye struggle here,
Soon to join the Angels' songs,

hymns.title: Wo Oluwa l'awosanma
verses: Awon to gan, awon to pa,
Awon ti a gan pelu Re,

hymns.title: Lo, He comes with clouds descending
verses: Swell the triumph of His train:
God appears on earth to reign,
God appears on earth to reign,
Those who set at nought and sold Him,
Pierc'd, and nail'd Him to the tree,
Gaze we on those glorious scars,
Gaze we on those glorious scars,
All His, saints, by men rejected,
Now shall meet Him in the air
See the day of God appear
See the day of God appear
Saviour, take the pow'r and glory;
Claim the kingdom for Thine own

hymns.title: Jesu yio tun padawa
chorus: Roju, roju, sa roju duro de Jesu

hymns.title: Jesus will soon return again
verses: To come down here and judge the world
He will take up his own beloved
To the place of eternal rest
If your wants and poverty comes
If friends and colleagues let you down
Just stand and hold on for Jesus
‘Tis those who endure till the end
Who will receive the crown of life
4.Even though your sickness is not healed
It can’t compare to the blessing
He will give to those who hold on
chorus: Hold on, stand and hold on for Jesus
Hold on, stand and hold on for Jesus
Hold on, hold on, just stand and hold on for Jesus

hymns.title: Ojo dajo, ojo eru
verses: Gbo bi ipe ti ndun to!
Bi esu naa, Bi esu naa
Gbogbo won ti nwo ona Re
Yio ha ti ri fun O?
A o segun, A o segun

hymns.title: Day of Judgement! Day of wonders!
verses: How the summons, how the summons
Ye who love the Lord's appearing
Then shall say, ‘This God is mine!',
Own me on that day as thine.
Rise to life from earth and sea;
All the pow'rs of nature, shaken
At his call prepare to flee;
What will then become of thee?
When these riches shall pass away
It shall find thee in the fire
My friend, think thou, My friend, think thou
Of thy grace in burning hell.
Let this word thy counsel be
The day of the Lord comes quickly
Then our tears will turn to joy.
When the world shall be on fire.

hymns.title: Jesu nbo lofurufu pel’ayo,
verses: Awon to fey o fo lo pade Re
Won yoo pade Oluwa ni sanma,
Gbogbo wa pelu Jesu yo wa nibe,
Won nbe lodo Kristi a ko ri won mo
Ibanuje ni lilo won je fun wa:
3.Gbogbo wa ha se tan fun bibo Re?
Omode ati agba ha se tan!
A nfe lati wa lodo Re laelae
Ka le ma wo oju ati ewa Re,
4.Awon miran ko ni le ba wa ko
Sugbon gbogbo wa ni ayo nbe fun
Ka le mura tan nipa'agbara Re,
Ninu ogo didan Re ka le ni

hymns.title: Jesus is coming with joy to the sky .
verses: 1.Jesus is coming with joy to the sky .
Oh, happy day! oh, happy day!
Then all who love Him shall
Upward shall fly to the Lord in the air;
Together with Jesus we all shall be there,
Far from the earth, and from sorrow and care
2.Parents and children shall then again meet,
Oh, happy day! oh happy day!
Sisters and brothers oh, it will be sweet!
We miss'd them on earth, to Jesus they went;
We love them as ever, their absence lament;
Soon we shall meet them, and then be content,
3.Are we all ready, should Jesus now call?
Oh, happy day! oh, happy day!
Would each one answer, the great and the small?
We long to rise up and with Thee to be,
Thy face, blessed Jesus, our Saviour to see
Would you then, dear children, sing
4.Some will stay weeping unable to sing,
Oh, happy day! oh, happy day!
Yet all may rejoice their glad praises bring;
For Jesus still waits, He tarries that we
May trust in His name, and thus ready may be,
When brightly beaming, His glory we see
Oh, happy day! happy day!       Amen

hymns.title: Iwo nbo wa, Oluwa mi,
verses: O ye ka yp, ka korin;
A ko ha ngbo ago Re.
A o ri O, a o mo O,
A o yin O, gbogbo okan
A o tu fe wa jade
T'a mo p'O npade okan wa
T'a nfe, t'a si nduro de
Ki won jumo fi fun O,

hymns.title: Thou art coming, O my Saviour,
verses: Thou art coming, O my King,
Well may we rejoice and sing;
Hear we not Thy golden bells?
We shall meet Thee on Thy way,
We shall see Thee, we shall know Thee,
We shall bless Thee, we shall show Thee
All our hearts could never say;
What an anthem that will be,
Pouring out our love to Thee
But Thy coming, and Thy throne,
All for which we long and wait.
4.Oh the joy to see Thee reigning
Brought to thee with one accord,
Thee, my Master and my Friend,

hymns.title: E gbe ori yin si oke,
verses: Ki keke ogun Re to de
Won je okan na titi lae,
Ka si f'iyin wa fun un

hymns.title: Lift up your heads, eternal gates:
verses: The King, the King of glory comes,
Who is the King of glory!
Who is the King of glory!
It is the Lord of might,
Triumphant o'er the powers of night.
Ye gates of pearl and streets of gold:
The King, the King of glory comes;
Who is the King of glory!
Who is the King of glory!
The Lord of hosts is He,
3.Now with the Father, God most High
And with the Spirit, ever one,
The angels own the Christ, the King
And bow before His shining throne,
He is the King of glory!
He is the King of glory!
For ever and for evermore.  Amen.

hymns.title: Jesu ti Baba ti gbega
verses: A ki yo ha mura de E?

hymns.title: Jesus whom God hath exalted,
verses: The same Jesus will soon come back
To judge the quick and the dead .
Shall we not prepare for Him?
Then full salvation we shall have
On that great and glorious day.
All the eyes shall there see Him.
And those that nail'd Him on the cross
4.Now with faith, I can boldly say,
That I'll go up with my Lord,
With Him to reign for thousand years
With the Lord, go to the sky,
Because their works has no reward
Which were done while here on earth
Thou who art the hope of world
Come Thou, Lord Jesus our Saviour
All our sorrows cease to be.     Amen.

hymns.title: Jesu kigbe pe, "Emi mbo
verses: Wa, k'okan wa ma baa daku

hymns.title: Jesus cries out that "I am come
verses: I am come with great love"
My heart in answer says come Lord
2.Come, Thou and do Thy father's will
Come, wake up thy dead messengers
And bring back our full assembly
Make Thou the day draw near
Come quickly that our heart faint not
When you tarry too long.     Amen.

hymns.title: Jesu t'o ga julo l'orun
verses: K'o le ba wa l'ayo.  Amin

hymns.title: Jesus the most high in heaven
verses: Made the world with His might
Thou who left Thy great majesty
That the world might be saved.
2.With humble He came to the world
May thro' this Lord be sav'd.
We have the priviledge of life
And shout, O ye for joy
5.Let Thy return on earth O Lord,
That waiting for Thee all our days
In joy, may we be found. Amen.

hymns.title: Jesu, l’ojo aanu yii
verses: B’ife na tit obi to -  Amin.

hymns.title: Lord, in this thy mercy's day,
verses: Ere the time shall pass away,
On our knees we fall and pray.
Ere the hour of doom appears.
Let us not Thy love forgo.
When we see Thee face to face.
Grant us neath Thy wings a place.
And that love will then be known
By the pardon'd round Thy throne.

hymns.title: Apata Ayeraye
verses: L'o le mu ofin Re se.
Mo wa ko d'aso bo mi,

hymns.title: Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
verses: 1. Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee;
Let the water and the blood,
From Thy wounded side which flowed,
Be of sin the double cure;
Save from wrath and make me pure.
2. Not the labor of my hands
Could my zeal no respite know,
All for sin could not atone;
Thou must save, and Thou alone.
3. Nothing in my hand I bring,
Simply to the cross I cling;
Naked, come to Thee for dress;
Helpless look to Thee for grace;
Foul, I to the fountain fly;
Wash me, Savior, or I die.
4. While I draw this fleeting breath,
When mine eyes shall close in death,
When I soar to worlds unknown,
See Thee on Thy judgment throne,
Rock of Ages, cleft for me,
Let me hide myself in Thee. Amen.

hymns.title: Elese -mo nfe 'bukun;
verses: Ese sa l'o yi mi ka,

hymns.title: Sinful, sighing to be blest;
verses: Bound, and longing to be free;
I can only bring my need;
Dare not lift themselves to Thee
To Thy bosom I would flee;
I am not my own but Thine;
And my only hope and plea
Are in Him, and Him alone,
He's my all; and for His sake

hymns.title: Approach, my soul, the mercy-seat
verses: There humbly fall before His feet
Thou callest burden'd souls to Thee,
And such, O Lord, am I.
3.Bow'd down beneath a load of sin,
By war without, and fears within,
I come to Thee for rest.
4.Be Thou my shield and hiding place,
I may my fierce accuser face,
And tell him, Thou hast died.
5.Oh wondrous love, to bleed and die,
To bear the cross and shame,
That guilty sinners, such as I,
Might plead Thy gracious name. Amen.

hymns.title: O Thou, from whom all goodness flows,
verses: 1.O Thou, from whom all goodness flows,
I lift my heart to Thee;
In all my sorrows conflicts, woes
Thy pardon grant, Thy peace impart
Oh let my strength be as my day;
4.If on my face for Thy dear name
All hail reproach, and welcome shame
5.And oh When in the hour of death
Be this the pray'r of my last breath,

hymns.title: Kilo le w'ese, mi nu
verses: Ki lo tun le wo mi san,
chorus: To mu mi fun bi sno

hymns.title: What can wash away my sin?
verses: Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
What can make me whole again?
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
For my pardon this my plea-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus.
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Nought of good that I have done-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
4.This is all my hope and peace-
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!
chorus: That makes me white as snow!
Nothing but the blood of Jesus!

hymns.title: F'ore-ofe Re ba wa gbe
verses: Ki o ma le kolu wa
Je ki oro Re s'amona wa
Ka ma gbe ara le aye
Mu wa duro ti o.  Amin.

hymns.title: Abide among us with Thy grace
verses: Nor let us e'er to sin
Thy help and mercy here afford
And let Thy truth preserve our way
4.Abide with us to bless us still.
With grace and pow'r our spirits fill,
That to the world we may not yield
Thy help in need, O let us prove,
And keep us true to Thee. Amen

hymns.title: Alaimo ni emi
verses: Yio ha si ti buru to

hymns.title: Unclean and full of sin
verses: Am I, O Lord my God,
I dare not venture near to Thee
I and my load of sin.
And how far more wicked it looks
There is joy in Thy atonement
Can wash the vilest sinner clean
Can melt the heart of stone.
5. I fall down at Thy feet
And here at Thy feet will

hymns.title: Nigbat' Idanwo yi mi ka
verses: T'o ni ki nteriba fun oun
Ti nko gbona, ti nko tutu,
chorus: Bi o ti pe Adam nin' ogba
Ki nle bo ninu ebi naa.

hymns.title: When temptations around me about
verses: When the foe appear as a friend
To world's highest hill then lift me
With his command to bow for him
That I may possess all world's lusts.
3.When glories of the world lends to.
Force me to go against Thy laws.
When behind me stood against me
With promise that, all will be well.
And idol and strange gods follow
And spells became my morning prayer.
5.When in my will, I love to walk
In heretic love of my heart
And when my heart moves here and there
When neither cold nor hot I am.
6.When I am lost like the bush dog.
Who fails to hear the hunter's call.
When hope to return failure be,
Then in sins I wallow always.
When sorrows like storm covers me,
And bow my head in repentance.
chorus: O Lord call upon me to come
As Thou in garden call'd Adam
Saying, where art thou o sinner
That I am from the fault be free

hymns.title: Bi mo ti ri laisawawi
verses: B'o si ti pe mi kinwa
Mo fe kokan mi mo toto
S'odo Re to le we mi mo
3.Bi mo ti ri bo tile je
5.Bi mo ti ri 'Wo o gba mi
Wo o gba mi t'owo t'ese
7.Bi mo ti ri - ife nla Re
Olugbala, mo de, mo de. Amin.

hymns.title: Just as I am, without one plea
verses: 1. Just as I am, without one plea
But that Thy blood was shed for me,
And that Thou bidd'st me come to Thee,
O Lamb of God, I come!, I come!
2.Just as I am, and waiting not
To rid my soul of one dark blot,
To Thee, whose blood can cleanse each spot,
O Lamb of God, I come, I come!
3.Just as I am, though tossed about
With many a conflict, many a doubt,
O Lamb of God, I come!, I come!
4.Just as I am, poor, wretched, blind;
Sight, riches, healing of the mind,
Yea, all I need, in Thee to find,
O Lamb of God, I come!, I come!
5.Just as I am, Thou wilt receive,
O Lamb of God, I come!, I come!
6.Just as I am, Thy love unknown
Now to be Thine, yea, Thine alone,
O Lamb of God, I come!, I come!
7.Just as I am, of that free love
The breath; length, depth, and height to prove,
Here for a season, then above,
O Lamb of God, I come!, I come!     Amen

hymns.title: A!   Jesu, Iwo nduro
verses: Ma fi wa sile. lo.    Amin.

hymns.title: Jesus, Thou art standing
verses: His name and sign who bear,
O shame, thrice shame upon us,
And lo! that hand is scarred,
And tears Thy face have marred.
O sin that hath no equal,
So fast to bar the gate!
I died for you, My children,
O Lord, with shame and sorrow

hymns.title: Ogooji, tosan toru
verses: La dan O wo, t'O si pe
2.A ki y'o pin n'nu iya Re?
Titi lae ka ro mo O
Ka le ba O ji dide

hymns.title: Forty days and forty nights
verses: Thou wast fasting in the wild;
Strong with thee to suffer pain?
Grant we may not faint or fall!
Round us, too, shall angels shine,
That we thee we may appear

hymns.title: Merciful Father Our God
verses: As we kneel by Mercy Seat
We have sinned before thy throne
You who prayed the Father God
Be our Helper all our days
Let no cause make us regret
The children and the grown ups
Forgive the work of your Hands

hymns.title: Mo kese mi le Jesu
verses: Mo ru ebi mi too wa
Le Jesu, O si gba mi
Mo fe ki nri bi Jesu
Mo nfe ki nba Jesu gbe

hymns.title: I lay my sins on Jesus,
verses: He bears them all, and frees us
I bring my guilt to Jesus.
White in His blood most precious,
I lay my griefs on Jesus,
I love the name of Jesus,
I long to be like Jesus,
I long to be with Jesus,
To sing with saints His praises,

hymns.title: Elese e yipada
verses: Eese ti e o fi ku?
To fe ki e ba oun gbe
Oran nla li o mbi yin
E ese te o ko 'fe. Re?
Eese ti e o fi ku
E o tun kan mo gi bi
Eese ti e o fi ku
Ti nfi ife Re ro yin
E ki o ha gbore Re?
A ti wa yin pe, eese
E. ki o ha gbooro re?
E ese ti e o fi ku?

hymns.title: Sinners, turn; why will ye die?
verses: God; your Maker, asks you why:
God, who did your being give,
Made you with Himself to live;
Asks the work of His own hands,
Will you cross His love, and die?
God, your Saviour, asks you why
God, who did your souls retrieve,
Will you let Him die in vain?
Will you slight His grace, and die?
God, the Spirit asks you why:
He who all your lives hath strove,
Wooed you to embrace His love;
Will you not His grace receive?
Will you still refuse to live?
Will you grieve your God, and die?
4.Can you doubt if God is love,
If to all His yearnings move?
Will you not His word receive
Will you not His oath believe?
Mingled with His blood they cry
"Why wilt you resolve to die?"    Amen.

hymns.title: O di odun metalaa
verses: 2.Mo wi wi wi, mo fo fo
Won ko gba oro Mi gbo

hymns.title: It is about thirteen years
verses: That I’ve come to show you love
2.I spoke, spoke and I taught you
All of them turned devil’s kin
They do not believe my words
And give them life without charge
To feed them without a charge
So that they may be at rest
So they may drink without cost
Burdens of sin from their neck
So they may have full freedom
And my burden is so light
You shall have rest for your souls
On the day when I come down
Because of the son of man
And obtain life at no cost
You who’s spirit is in tune

hymns.title: Jesus, Rock of living water
verses: Our father drank of the water
2. What is it that brought about this
They did not do the will of God
3. The ones that were so stone-hearted
4. Beware o you people of the Lord
So that you will not die
Just because of your great pride
As it was at the start
So it is even at this time
And will be for ever.  Amen

hymns.title: Jina s'ile orun
verses: A!  nba le fo de be

hymns.title: Far from my heav'nly home,
verses: Fainting I cry, Blest Spirit, come,
And speed me to my rest.
How should I sing a cheerful song,
My heart, O Zion, droops and yearns,
When shall I pass the wilderness
On Thee my hopes I cast
Oh guide me through the desert here,
And bring me home at last.     Amen.

hymns.title: Ma gesin lo l’olanla Re,
verses: Lati ri ebo ti ao ru.
Lehin naa, dide k'O joba. Amin.

hymns.title: Ride on, ride on in majesty!
verses: Hark! all the tribes Hosanna! cry;
O Saviour meek, pursue Thy road,
With palms and scattered garment strow'd.
In lowly pomp ride on to die,
O Christ Thy triumphs now begin
O'er captive death and conquer'd sin.
The winged squadrons of the sky
Look down with sad and wondering eyes
Thy last and fiercest strife is nigh;
The Father on His sapphire throne
In lowly pomp ride on to die!

verses: 1. Take up thy cross, the Saviour said,

My strength shall bear thy spirit up,
And brace thy heart, and nerve thine arm.
3. Take up thy cross, nor heed the shame,
Nor let thy foolish pride rebel;
Thy Lord for thee the Cross endured,
To save thy soul from death and hell.
4. Take up thy cross then in His strength,
'Twill guide thee to a better home,
And lead to victory o'er the grave.
5. Take up thy cross, and follow Christ
Nor think till death to lay it down;
For only he who bears the cross
May hope to wear the glorious crown.

O grant us in our Hope to see
