Rest, for a Father seals in heaven
4.Rest ye, who cluster round them both
Your God affirms the plighted troth,
And in this union draws more near

hymns.title: Eleda orun at' aye
verses: Ti o da ni tako tabo
K' o jeso idapo nla yii.
K' oko fi sona f aya re;
Ki won fi jowu ara won.
Fun t' oko t' aya ninu ile;
Je kawa le ma juba Re;

hymns.title: Maker of heaven and the earth
verses: 1. Maker of heaven and the earth
Of the love of Jesus for His church
2. Come and join us holy Jesus
Our God, the great majestic King
Bless both the husband and the wife
3. Let the evil one flee from us
Good children, good and happy home
Be the fruit of this great union
4. Meekness like that of Jesus Christ
Husband have it towards the wife
Let them have towards each other
5. Give your complete and pure blessing
To the husband and wife in the house
6. Jesus is the head of the church
And let us bow down before you
In all of our matrimony.   Amen

hymns.title: Olorun ife, a juba
verses: T' o dabi pe gbogbo re pin
Mu won je kan nnu Re.

hymns.title: O God of Love, to Thee we bow;
verses: 1.O God of Love, to Thee we bow;
And pray for those before Thee now,
That closely knit in holy vow,
They may in Thee be one.
2.When days are filled with pure delight,
When paths are plain and skies are bright.
Walking by faith and not by sight,
May they in Thee be one,
And all their good seems turned to ill,
May they in Thee be one
4.Whate'er in life shall be their share
Of quick'ning joy or burd'ning care
In pow'r to do and grace to bear
May they in Thee be one.
In Thee for ever may they hide
Those whom Thou makest one. Amen.

hymns.title: Baba, Eleda gbogbo
verses: Ko won lati mo O li
B' Iwo ko si nile won

hymns.title: O Father, all-creating,
verses: A home by Thee made blessed,
A love by Thee kept true.
With these who wait on Thee;
And teach them, in the tasting,
To know the gift is Thine.
From sin and strife kept free,
Their lives may own Thy guidance
Their hearts he ruled by Thee,
The house is built in vain;
The joy will turn to pain:
But nought can break the union
Of hearts in Thee made one,
And love which Thou hast hallowed,

hymns.title: Irapada itan iyanu
verses: Jesu ti ra idariji fun wa
O san gbese naa lor' igi.
2.Ese ki y' ole joba wa mo
Bo ti wu ko dan wa wo to
P' agbara ese run fun wa.
O si so wa d’ omo Olorun
We nin' eje naa k 'osi mo.
4.Gba aanu t' Olorun fi lo o,
Tori y' o gb' enito ba too wa
Ki yoo si da pada lae.
chorus: A! elese gba ihin naa gbo
To mu igbala fun O wa.

hymns.title: Redemption oh, wonderful story
verses: Glad message for you and for me
That Jesus has purchased our pardon,
And paid all the debt on the tree.
2.From death unto life He hath brought us
And made us by grace Sons of God;
A fountain is opened for sinners;
Oh, wash and be cleans'd in the blood.
Though present to tempt and annoy;
For Christ, in His blessed redemption,
The power of sin shall destroy.
For He will receive him that cometh,
And never will turn him away. Amen.
chorus: Believe it, O sinner, believe it,
Trust now in the crucified Saviour

hymns.title: Igbagbo mi duro lori
verses: B'o ti wu k' iji na le to
L' em' o ro mo b'ikunmi de
O je ireti nla fun mi.
A! nba le wa ninu Jesu

hymns.title: My hope is built on nothing less
verses: 1.My hope is built on nothing less
No merit of my own I claim,
But wholly lean on Jesus' name,
2. When long appears my toilsome race,
I rest on His unchanging grace;
My anchor holds within the veil,
Support me in the whelming flood;
When every earthly prop gives way,
He then is all my hope and stay.
4.When the last trumpet's voice shall sound,
Oh may I then in Him be found.
Faultless to stand before the throne.
chorus: On Christ, the solid rock, I stand;
All other ground is sinking sand.
On Christ, the solid rock, I stand;
All other ground is sinking sand.

hymns.title: N' irumi at' iji aye
verses: O nso si mi l'eti Wipe
Ti f’ agbara won lu mi
Won ko le se O nibi mo
Oju mi ko ye lara re
Wo ko le mo kikoro re
Emi ti mo bi o ti ri
6.Gbat emi re ba pin l' aye
T’awon t' orun wa pade re
'Wo o gbohun kan to mo pe

hymns.title: Toss'd with rough winds, and faint
verses: 1.Toss'd with rough winds, and faint with fear,
Above the tempest, soft and clear,
What still small accents greet mine ear?
2.‘Tis I, who washed thy spirit while
‘Tis I, who gave thy blind eyes sight
'Tis I, thy Lord, Thy life, Thy light
Have spent their deadly force on Me:
They bear no breath of wrath to thee:
4.This bitter cup, I drank it first;
To thee it is no draught accurst;
The hand that gives it thee is pierced:
5. Mine eyes are watching by thy bed,
Mine arms are underneath thy head,
My blessing is around thee shed;
6.When on the other side thy feet
Shall rest, mid thousand welcomes sweet,
One well-known Voice thy heart shall greet,

hymns.title: Igbagbo mi wo O
verses: A! k' ife mi si O

hymns.title: My faith looks up to Thee,
verses: Now hear me while I pray;
O let me from this day
As Thou hast died for me,
O may my love to Thee

hymns.title: Nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
verses: 1. Nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
E'en though it be a cross that raiseth me,
still all my song shall be,
nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
2. Though like the wanderer, the sun gone down,
darkness be over me, my rest a stone;
yet in my dreams I'd be
Nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
3. There let the way appear, steps unto heaven;
all that thou sendest me, in mercy given;
Nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
4. Then, with my waking thoughts bright with thy praise,
out of my stony griefs Bethel I'll raise;
so by my woes to be
Nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!
5. Or if, on joyful wing cleaving the sky,
sun, moon, and stars forgot, upward I fly,
still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee!

hymns.title: Gbat' a b' Oluwa rin
verses: Ogo nla lo fi si ona wa
Oun yoo maa ba wa gbe
T’Olugbala wa ko le le lo
T' Olugbala ki yo san fun wa
Yoo segun f awon to gbekele.
Afi ba ko aniyan wa le
Oju rere Re nbe Pelu ayo giga
K' Oun si ma ba wa lo lona wa
A ki yoo beru ao gbekele

hymns.title: When we walk with the Lord
verses: 1. When we walk with the Lord
In the light of His Word
What a glory He sheds on our way!
Let us do His good will;
And with all who will trust and obey.
2. Not a shadow can rise, not a cloud in the skies
But His smile quickly drives it away
Not a doubt or a fear, not a sigh or a tear
Can abide while we trust and obey
But our toil He doth richly repay;
Not a grief or a loss,
Not a frown or a cross,
But is blest if we trust and obey.
Until all on the alter we lay;
Are for them who will trust and obey.
We will sit at His feet
Or we'll walk by His side in the way;
What He says we will do,
Where He sends we will go;
Never fear, only trust and obey.

hymns.title: Mo gb' ohun Jesu to wi pe
verses: 1.Mo gb' ohun Jesu to wi pe
Lodo Re, mo r' ibi simi
Mo to Jesu wa, mo si mu
3.‘Mole aye gb'ohun Jesu to wi pe
Wo mi o Orun re yoo si la
Mo wo Jesu n'nu Re mo
N'nu 'mole Re l'emi y' o rin
Titi ajo mi yoo pin. Amin

hymns.title: I heard the voice of Jesus say;
verses: 1.I heard the voice of Jesus say;
Lay down, thou weary one lay down
I came to Jesus as I was,
I found in Him a resting-place,
And He has made me glad.
2.I heard the voice of Jesus say,
Stoop down and drink, and live!
I came to Jesus, and I drank
My thirst was quenched, my soul revived,
And now I live in Him.
3.I heard the voice of Jesus say,
I am this dark world's Light;
Look unto Me, thy morn shall rise,
And all thy day be bright!
I looked to Jesus, and I found
In Him my Star, my Sun;
And in that light of life I'll walk
Till traveling days are done. Amen

hymns.title: Oh, for a faith that will not shrink
verses: 1.Oh, for a faith that will not shrink
That will not tremble on the brink
But, in the hour of grief of pain
3.A faith that shines more bright and clear
That when in danger knows no fear,
4.A faith that keeps the narrow way
Till life's last spark is fled,
And with a pure and heav'nly ray
5.Lord, give me such a faith as this,
I taste e'en now the hallow'd bliss

hymns.title: Lai si Re nko le da rin
verses: 1. Lai si Re nko le da rin
2. Lai si Re nko le da rin
3. Lai si Re nko le da rin
Bawo mo se le da rin
Iwo lo mo na to mo
Ko seda kan to le mo
Ti o le te mi lorun
Wo ki yoo fi mi sile
Mo mo pe O sunmo mi

hymns.title: Without you, I can’t go on
verses: The blood of Him that saved me
With His precious and pure blood
Is my hope and my comfort
2. Without you, I can’t go on
Is all in all, my portion
My weakness will turn to strength
If I put my trust in you.
And I have lost my strength
How could I go on alone
I do not know the right path
Only you knows the pure path
With you, I shall not stray
Who knows the great pain in my heart
There’s no one living who knows
The worries deep in my heart
But you, my Lord and God
When the time comes for me to die
Life is full of vain pursuits
If you are not involved in it
You promised not to leave me
Though huge storms rise against me
I know that you are by my side

hymns.title: Baba mi gba nba/ nsako lo
verses: Ko mi ki nle wi/ bayii pe
Ko mi ki ngba ki/nmase kun
Ti ara oun p/re ko si
Ohun to se o/won fun mi
Ngo fi fun O, se/Tire ni
Ki Oun ko si ma/ba mi

hymns.title: My God my Father, while I stay
verses: 1.My God my Father, while I stay
Far from my home, on life’s rough way,
Oh teach me from my heart to say,
2.Though dark my path and sad my lot,
Let me be still and murmur not;
Or breath the pray’r divinely taught,
3.What though in lonely grief I sigh
For friends belov’d no longer nigh
4.If Thou should’st call me to resign
What most I prize, it ne’er was mine:
I only yield Thee what is Thine;
5.Let but my fainting heart be blest
With Thy sweet Spirit for its guest,
My God, to Thee I leave the rest,
6.Renew my will from day to day
Blend it with Thine, and take away
All that now makes it hard to say,
7.Then, when on earth I breathe no more,
The pray’r oft mix’d with tears  before,
I’ll sing upon a happier shore,

hymns.title: Onigbagbo e ma beru
verses: B' esu ngbo tasi re si wa
B' iku npa lotun npa losi
3.Ki lohun ti nba o l' eru
Aye ko le ri wa gbese
Ina esu ko le jo ni

hymns.title: All believers do not have fear
verses: If the devil goes on barking
Christ our Lord is our Chief General
He will crush the devil’s device
The devil will bow under Him
2.Though we walk through valley of death
If death strikes down from right and left
Keep on marching, men of valour
Christ, the Captain is before us
3.What is it that gives you much fear
As long as Jesus is with us
The mountain shall turn to valley
The world won’t prevail over us
So shall we stand with our Jesus

hymns.title: Alaafia, li aye ese yi?
verses: L' aya Jesu ni dake roro wa.
Sugbon a mo pe Jesu wa laelae.
Jesu yo pe wa s'orun alaafia. Amin.

hymns.title: Peace, perfect peace, in this dark
verses: 1.Peace, perfect peace, in this dark world of sin?
The blood of Jesus whispers peace within.
2.Peace, perfect peace, by thronging duties pressed?
To do the will of Jesus, this is rest.
3.Peace, perfect peace, with sorrows surging round?
On Jesus' bosom nought but calm is found.
4.Peace, perfect peace, with lov'd ones far away?
In Jesus' keeping we are safe and they.
5.Peace, perfect peace, our future all unknown?
Jesus we know, and lie is on the throne.
6.Peace, perfect peace, death shad'wing us-and ours?
Jesus has vanquish'd death and all its pow'rs,
7. It is enough: earth's struggles soon shall cease,
And Jesus call us to heav'n perfect peace. Amen.

hymns.title: Save in the arms of Jesus,
verses: There by His love o’er shaded,
Borne in a strong to me,
Free from the blight of sorrow
Free from my doubts and fear
Firm on the Rock of Ages
Here let me wait with patience,
Wait till the night is o’er:
Wait till I see the morning
chorus: Safe in  the arms of Jesus,
There by His love o’er shaded,

hymns.title: Jesu a w' odo Re
verses: To wa wa b' awa ti pejo
Si ko wa, ka lo aye wa
K' awa at' awon le pade

hymns.title: Jesus we come to Thee
verses: Come Thou to us as here we meet
Teach us that here may be the star
That we and him may meet above

hymns.title: K' awa to pari eko wa
verses: Ma je ka pada lehin Re
Ka le ri aye lodo Re,

hymns.title: O Lord, our hearts would give Thee praise
verses: 1. O Lord, our hearts would give Thee praise
Ere now our school we end,
For this Thy day, the best of days,
2.Lord, grant Thy word in every heart,
That we from Thee may ne'er depart,
3.Lord, bless our homes and give us grace
That We in heav'n may find a place,
With Thee, the children's Friend. Amen.

hymns.title: Olorun, 'gbat'okan mi wo
verses: Iran naa mu ki emi kun
Owo anu Re l'o to mi,
Ati f okan to m'ore Re,

hymns.title: When all thy mercies, oh my God
verses: 1. When all thy mercies, oh my God
Transported with the view, am lost
3. When in the slippery parts of youth
Thine arm, unseen, conveyed me safe
And led me up to man
4. Through hidden dangers, toils, and deaths
And through the pleasing snares of vice
More to be feared than they
5. When one with sickness oft hast thou
And when in sins and sorrow sunk
Nor is the least a cheerful heart
That tastes those gifts with joy
7. Though every period of my life
And after death in distant worlds
To utter all thy praise. Amen

hymns.title: Ajagun tooto ha l'emi?
verses: 3. Ota ko ha po fun mibi?
Ore aiye ko ha se tan

hymns.title: Am I a true soldier indeed?
verses: 1. Am I a true soldier indeed?
Shall I be afraid of the war?
2. Shall I be after futile things?
3. Ain’t the foes too many for me?
Are friends of this world not prepared
4. I should fight, and then I will reign
Hold me up, O my Lord
The divine Spirit of the Cross
5. We your soldiers in the world here
We have seen vict’ry from afar
6. When that day of the Lord shall come
Through the dangers, we shall conquer
The glory shall be Yours. Amen.

hymns.title: Oju kan mbe tiki to gbe,
verses: 1. Oju kan mbe tiki to gbe,
Eti kan si mbe tiki ise,
2. Apa kan mbe, tiko le re
Ife kan mbe, tiko le ku

hymns.title: There’s an eye that never sleeps
verses: Beneath the wing of the night;
There is an ear that never shuts,
When sin the beam of light
2. There is an arm that never tires
There is a love that never fails,
3. That eye is fix’d on seraph throngs;
That ear is fill’d with angel songs:
That love is throned on high
4. But there’s a pow’r, which man can wield
That eye, that arm, that love to reach
5. That power is pray’r, which soars on high
And moves the hand, which moves the world,
Let us have stedfast faith and love
So we can pray the more.Amen.

hymns.title: Ko mi Oluwa, bia ti
verses: B'o ti wa mi, Je k'emi wa
Awon Omo Re t'o ti nu.
Kinle mo, bo ti ye lati
Titi Okan mi yo fi kun
Titi em' o fi r'oju Re,
Ti un o pin ninu Ogo Re. Amin

hymns.title: Lord, speak to me, that I may speak
verses: 1. Lord, speak to me, that I may speak
In living echoes to Thy tone;
As Thou has sought so let me seek
Thy erring children lost and lone
2. Oh, lead me, Lord that I may lead
The wand’ring and the wav’ring feet;
O, feed me, Lord, that I may feed
Thy hung’ring ones with manna sweet
3. Oh, strengthen me, that while I stand
Firm on the Rock, and strong in Thee
I may stretch out a loving hand
To wrestlers with the troubl’d sea.
4. Oh, teach me, Lord that I may teach
The precious things Thou dost impart,
And wing my words that they may reach
The hidden depths of many hearts.
5. Oh, give Thine own sweet rest to me,
That I may speak with soothing pow’r
A word in season, as from Thee,
To weary ones in needful hour.
6. Oh, fill me with Thy fullness, Lord,
In kindling thought, and glowing word,
The love to tell, Thy praise to show
7. Oh, use me, Lord, use me
Just as Thou wilt, and how, and where
Untill Thy blessed face I see,
Thy rest, thy joy, Thy glory share. Amen

hymns.title: E je k'a yin Olugbala
verses: T'O pase K'a tun jo pade,
2. O pase k'a gbe 'ra wa ro;
Ayo wa y'o ti tobi to,

hymns.title: Let us all praise the Redeemer
verses: 1. Let us all praise the Redeemer
Who made us all as one
Who commands that we meet again
For us to seek His face.
2. He commands that we stand upright
3. The gift He gave us, one by one
The grace flows freely in our midst
In the love that is pure
4. Our thoughts and speech are united
5. We do share our joy together
As well as peace of mind
The same peace that the world know not
Is this sweet in this world
How tremendous will our joy be
When we go round His throne. Amen

hymns.title: Iwo to nmu okan mole
verses: Ki ijo Re le je mimo
K' atupa Re ma jo gere.
Ki won je 'nit' Iwo ti ko
San ju oba aye yi lo
Titi aye osi yii yoo pin.
L'aye yii l'a o ti logo
La o mo ohun ti aiku je. Amin.

hymns.title: O Thou Who makest souls to shine
verses: 1.O Thou Who makest souls to shine
With light from brighter worlds above;
On all who seek a Saviour’s love
On all who teach, on all who learn,
That all Thy Church may holier live
And every lamp more brightly burn.
3.Give those that teach pure hearts and wise,
Faith, hope, and love, all warmed by pray'r;
Themselves first training for the skies,
They best will raise their people there.
4.Give those that learn the willing ear,
The spirit meek, the guiless mind;
Such gifts win make the lowliest here
Far better than a kingdom find.
5.Oh! bless the shepherd; bless the sheep,
That guide and guided both be one
One, in the faithful watch they keep,
Until this hurrying life be done.
6.If thus, good Lord, Thy grace be giv'n,
Our glory meet us ere we die;
Before we upward pass to Heav'n

hymns.title: Ile Eko ojo isimi
verses: T' agba t' ewe wa nkorin re
Ninu re l' emi o wa.

hymns.title: O Sunday School on the Lord’s day
verses: 1.O Sunday School on the Lord’s day
O how  I love  thee well
I am happy, it makes me glad
2.O Sunday School on the Lord’s day
Both young and old will sing Thy song
3.O Sunday School on the Lord’s day
4.O Sunday School on the Lord’s day
5.O Sunday School, on the Lord’s day,
Though the sun be so bright
Or if the clouds be black with rain,
6.O Sunday School, on the Lord's day
Will Thou pass over me today

hymns.title: Iwo oro Olorun
verses: Ti won o r'oju Re. Amin.

hymns.title: O Word of God incarnate,
verses: O light of our dark sky,
We praise Thee for the radiance
Shines on from age to age.
And still that light she lifeth
O'er all the earth to shine;
Where gems of truth are stored
It is the chart and compass
Mid mists, and rocks, and quick-sands,
Stille guides, O Christ, to Thee.
Thy true light, as of old;
By this their path to trace,
They see Thee face to face.    Amen

hymns.title: Jesu oro Re ye
verses: Ki a ba le fe O
K'a si le sunmo O. Amin.

hymns.title: Lord, Thy word abideth,
verses: Then Thy word doth cheer us,
Lord, may love and fear Thee,

hymns.title: Baba orun, nin oro Re
verses: Titi lae l'a o maa yin O
Ki nmaa ri ogbon titun ko
Ko mi lati fe Ore Re

hymns.title: Father of mercies, in Thy word
verses: For ever be Thy name adored
And still new beauties may I see,
Teach me to love Thy sacred word,
And view my Saviour there. Amen

hymns.title: Emi orun mi s'oro naa
verses: 2.Ogo nla tan s' oju iwe naa
F'ore nla t' o se yi

hymns.title: The spirit breathes upon the word
verses: 1. The spirit breathes upon the word
The Lord shows a good example
And He brings in the light
2. A great glory shines upon the book
Just like that of the sun
He gives light to all the whole world
3. The honour He gives never hastes
His truth shines brightly like the day
4. Lord we give you all thanks and praise
You took away the world’s darkness
The path to One I love
Till I see the radiant glory

hymns.title: Bibel'iwe ayeraye
verses: Jo tumo ara re fun mi

hymns.title: The Bible everlasting book
verses: Your beginning on earth who knows?
And who can know Thy end?
2.The secrets of the God of heaven;
The sword that kill'd the sting of death,
Thou made salvation way so plain
Show me the Saviour's love.  Amen.

hymns.title: 'Tori Mi at' Ihinrere
verses: A fo aso won n'nu eje

hymns.title: "For my sake and the Gospel's go
verses: 1. "For my sake and the Gospel's go
And Thine, Lord, all the glory!"
They preach His Birth, His Life His Cross.
For whom they count the world but loss,
From pole to pole, by land and sea
As nearer draws the day of doom,
The Heavenly Day-spring through the gloom
Breaks on the night of ages.
3.Still on and on the anthems spread
In concert with the holy Dead
Their snow-white robes are washed in Blood,
Earth and the Paradise of God
The Lord of Saints and Angels
O Life, Light, Love, the great I AM,
The Throne of God and of the Lamb
Is Thine, and Thine for ever!Amen.

hymns.title: Bibeli mimo t'orun
verses: 'Wo ti nwi bi mo ti ri
'Wo ti nso bi mo ti wa.

hymns.title: The holy Word from heaven
verses: You who tells of my own state
You who speaks of my standing
2. You teach me if I get lost
You show me the love of God
It is You who guides my feet
3. It is you who consoles us
In the troubles of this world
You teach us to have the faith
4. You speak of the joy to come

hymns.title: Emi Mimo, mi s'okan wa,
verses: Iwo lo n fi ooto han wa

hymns.title: Come, Holy Ghost, our hearts inspire,
verses: Source of the old prophetic fire,
2.If Come, Holy Ghost, for moved by Thee
Unlock the truth, Thyself the key,
And let there now be light.
4.God, through I himself, we then shall know,
And sound, with all Thy saints below,

hymns.title: Iwe kan wa ti kika re
verses: A ko won sinu iwe na
Fun mi l' okan lati wa O

hymns.title: There is a Book that all may read,
verses: 1. There is a Book that all may read,
And all the lore its scholars need,
2. The works of God above, below,
Are pages in that Book, to show
4. One Name, above all glorious names,
5. Two worlds are ours: ’tis only sin
The mystic heaven and earth within,
Plain as the sea and sky.
6. Thou, who hast giv’n me eyes to see,
And love this sight so fair,
Give me a heart to find out Thee,

hymns.title: How shall our children and young ones
verses: 1.How shall our children and young ones
Take heed and cleanse their way,
It gives wisdom to the simple,
3.Thy word, is sun, our light Divine,
A lamp unto our feet always
It is all clean and pure,
Our guide in all our joyful days,
A staff for our old age. Amen.

hymns.title: Emi ba le f'iwa pele
verses: Ki nni imole ti nto mi
Sugbon won ti b' afo sile
Mo ko ese t'o bi O n' nu
Ba mi yo kuro lokan mi;

hymns.title: O for a closer walk with God
verses: 1.O for a closer walk with God
A light to shine upon the road
That leads, me to the Lamb.
When first I saw the Lord?
But they have left an aching void
I hate the sins that made Thee mourn,
And drove Thee from my breast
Help me to tear it from Thy throne,
6.So shall my walk be close with God,
So purer light shall mark the road
That leads me to the Lamb .    Amen.

hymns.title: E jek' a to Jesu wa lo
verses: 1.E jek' a to Jesu wa lo
2. K'a wo b' O ti dojubole
Eru ese wa l' O gbe ru
Nitori re ni Baba ko O

hymns.title: Let us go boldly to Jesus
verses: 1. Let us go boldly to Jesus
To the place where he goes to pray
2. Let’s see Him as he bows his head
He carries our burden of sin
The sin of the whole world
Because of you, He was alone
4. Will you not reason in yourself

hymns.title: Oke kan mbe jina rere
verses: 2.A ko le mo, a ko le so
Sugbon a mo pe n'tori wa
K' a maa se ife Re. Amin

hymns.title: There is a green hill far away,
verses: 1.There is a green hill far away,
Where the dear Lord was crucified
Who died to save us all.
2.We may not know, we cannot tell
What pains He had to bear,
But we believe it was for us
3.He died that we might be forgiv'n,
He died to make us good,
That we might go at last to heav'n
To pay the price of sin;
He only could unlock the gate
Of heav'n, and let us in.
And we must love Him too,
And trust in His redeeming blood,
And try His works to do.Amen.

hymns.title: 'Wo Od'aguntan Olorun
verses: Mo nfe we ninu eje Re
2.Gba okan mi, ki O fi se
Won nrin, won mbe laaye n'nu Re.
K'O ba O jokoo n'te Re.
K'O to mi Emi 'ye si wa!
Awa yadi, a ki o ni
Tu wa l'ahon, ki a le so
Woo! a te okan ba fun O
Wo la fokan at' ori fun;

hymns.title: I thirst, thou wounded Lamb of God,
verses: 1. I thirst, thou wounded Lamb of God,
To wash me in thy cleansing blood,
To dwell within thy wounds; then pain
Is sweet, and life or death is gain.
2. Take my poor heart, and let it be
For ever closed to all but thee!
Seal thou my breast, and let me be;
That pledge of love for ever there!
3. How blest are they who still abide
Close sheltered in thy bleeding side,
Who life and strength from thence derive,
And by thee move, and in thee live.
4. What are our works but sin and death,
Till thou thy quickening Spirit breathe!
Thou giv'st the power thy grace to move;
O wondrous grace! O boundless love!
5. How can it be, thou heavenly King,
That thou shouldest us to glory bring?
Make slaves the partners of thy throne,
6. Hence our hearts melt, our eyes o'erflow,
Our words are lost; nor will we know,
Nor will we think of aught beside,
7. Ah, Lord! enlarge our scanty thought,
To know the wonders thou hast wrought;
Unloose our stammering tongues, to tell
To thee, lo! all our souls we bow:
To thee our hearts and hands we give:
Thine may we die, thine may we live! Amen.

hymns.title: E gb'ohun ife at'aanu
verses: Ti odo Kristi san si wa:

hymns.title: Hark!, the voice of love and mercy
verses: 1.Hark!, the voice of love and mercy
See, it rends the rocks asunder!
Shakes the earth and veils the sky
Finished what our God had promised:
Death and hell no more need awe.
Saints, from hence your comfort draw.
All on earth and all in Heaven

hymns.title: Gbati mo ri agbelebu
verses: Ti a kan Oba ogo mo,
Gbogbo nnkan asan ti mo fe
Mo ko sile fun eje Re.
Ko to ore ti nba mu wa
Ye k'o gba gbogbo emi mi. Amin

hymns.title: When I survey the wondrous Cross
verses: On which the Prince of Glory died
My richest gain I count but loss,
And pour contempt on all my pride.
2.Forbid it, Lord, that I should boast
Save in the death of Christ my God;
All the vain things that charm me most
I sacrifice them to His blood.
3.See from His head. His hands, His feet,
Sorrow and love flow mingled down;
Did e'er such love and sorrow meet.
Or thorns compose so rich a crown?
4.Were the whole realm of nature mine
That were an offering far too small
Demands my soul, demands my all Amen.

hymns.title: Ooto ha ni
verses: O ye k'okan mi kun fope
Mo f'ara mi fun Oba mi
Eyi l'o ye ki nse. Amin

hymns.title: Alas! And did my Savior bleed,
verses: 1. Alas! And did my Savior bleed,
Would he devote that sacred head
2. Was it for crimes that I have done,
3. Well might the sun in darkness hide,
When God, the mighty maker, died
4. Thus might I hide my blushing face
And melt mine eyes to tears.
5. But drops of tears can ne'er repay
The debt of love I owe.
Here, Lord, I give myself away;
'Tis all that I can do.  Amen.

hymns.title: Iwo Od'agutan
verses: T’ o ta 'je Re fun wa
T' o mu wa jade ni Egypt

hymns.title: Thou very Lamb of God
verses: Whose blood for us was shed,
Through whom we out of Egypt came
To guard and feed the chosen race,
Be thou a cooling cloud by day,
And ever on Thy people rain
The manna of Thy love.  Amen

hymns.title: Gbogbo eje eran
verses: Ko le f okan l' alaafia

hymns.title: Not all the blood of beasts,
verses: 1. Not all the blood of beasts,
Could give the guilty conscience peace,
On that dear head of Thine,
While like a penitent I stand,
4. My soul looks back to see
When hanging on the cursed tree,
And knows her guilt was there.
We bless the Lamb with cheerful voice
And sing His bleeding love!  Amen.

hymns.title: Iye wa ni wiwo Enit' a kan mo 'gi
verses: 1.Iye wa ni wiwo Enit' a kan mo 'gi
Nje woo, elese, K'o le ri igbala
Wo Enit'a kan mo 'gi fun o,
Bi a ko gb'ebi re ru Jesu
Eje 'wenumo se san lat' iha Re
B'iku Re ko j'eetu f'ese re?
Sugbon eje naa lo seetu f'okan
Nje gbe eru ese re lo si odo
Ko s'ohun to ku lati se mo
Ati pe Oun yo wa nikehin aye
Li owo Jesu ti nfi fun ni
Si mo daju pe iwo ko le ku lae
chorus: Iye wa ni wiwo Enit' a kan mo 'gi

hymns.title: There is live for a look at the Crucified One
verses: 1.There is live for a look at the Crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee
Then, look, sinner, look unto Him and be saved
Unto Him who was nailed to the tree
3.It is not tears of repentance or prayers
But the Blood that atones for the soul
On Him, then, who shed it thou mayest at once
4.Then doubt not thy welcome since God has declared
There remaineth no more to be done
That once in the end of the world He appeared
And completed the work He begun
5.Then take with rejoicing from Jesus at once
And know with assurance thou never canst die
Since Jesus thy righteousness lives. Amen.
chorus: There is life for a look at the Crucified One
There is life at this moment for thee.

hymns.title: Mu mi ro m' Agbelebu
verses: Ki nle ba O rin dopin

hymns.title: Jesus, keep me near the cross;
verses: 1. Jesus, keep me near the cross;
Free to all, a healing stream,
2. Near the cross, a trembling soul,
There the bright and morning star
3. Near the cross! O Lamb of God,
Help me walk from day to day
4. Near the cross I'll watch and wait,
Till I reach the golden strand
chorus: In the cross, in the cross,
Till my raptured soul shall find

hymns.title: Dide tan imole 'torimole re de
verses: 2. Gbe oju re soke yika ki o si wo
Gbogbo won sa ara won jo po
Awon omo re okunrin'yoo jade wa
A o toju awon 'mo obirin re
3. Nigbanaa iwo ori oju re, yoo si mole
Okan re yoo si pada wa
Gbogbo eda aye yoo mu ebun wa
Won o yin Oluwa lara re
Awon ti o ngan O yoo te ori ba
Won o pe o ni omo Oluwa
5.Oorun re ki yoo wo Oluwa ni imole re,
Awon ti o ngan O yoo te ori ba
Won o pe o ni omo Oluwa
Olorun oba wa ti kii se aseti
Yoo si ran o lowo de opin
chorus: Ade mi yoo ha ri irawo
Ti Jesu yoo gunwa lori 'te naa
Ade mi yoo ha ri irawo.
addedChorus: Ade re yoo si ri irawo
Ti Jesu yoo gunwa lori 'te naa
Ade re yoo si ri irawo.

hymns.title: Arise, Shine like a star, because your light has come
verses: 1.Arise, Shine like a star, because your light has come
The glory of God breaks forth in you
Because a great darkness has covered the whole world
But the beauty of God shines in you
2. Lift your eyes, look around and you shall observe that
Your children, who are men, all of them, will come forth
We will care for your female children
3.Then you shall look on Him and your eyes will light up
And your heart shall be in calming peace
All men of all places shall bring you lots of gifts
They shall praise the Mighty God in you
4.Even all those who torment you will come to you
They will humbly bow down before you
The people who mock you will bow their heads to you
They shall all call you the child of God
5.Your sun shall not set, God is the source of your light
Those fasting days shall come to an end
The people who mock you will bow their heads to you
They shall all call you the child of God
We salute you for the work of God
Our Lord God, Reigning King who has never failed us
He will help you till the very end
chorus: Shall my crown look upon the great light
When we shall reach the glorious White Throne
And Jesus seats victoriously on it
Shall my crown look upon the great light
addedChorus: Shall your crown look upon the great light
When we shall reach the glorious White Throne
And Jesus seats victoriously on it
Shall your crown look upon the great light

hymns.title: Oore-ofe! ohun
verses: O pa mi mo titi d'oni
Ki nle fi gbogbo ipa mi

hymns.title: Grace! 'tis a charming sound,
verses: Heaven with the echo shall resound,
And all the earth shall hear,
'Twas grace that gave me to the Lamb,
And new supplies-each hour I meet,
‘Twas grace which kept me to this day,
And will not let me go.
May all my pow'rs to Thee aspire.
And all my days be Thine.

hymns.title: K' Olorun soo, ka tun pade;
verses: Ki imoran re gbe o ro,
K'o ka o mo aguntan Re,
K' Olorun soo, k'a tun pade.
K' Olorun so o k'a tun pade.
3.K' Olorun so o k'a tun pade
Nigbat' ewu ba yi o ka
K'o f owo ife Re gba o mu
K' Olorun so o, k'a tun pade.
4.K' Olorun so o k'a tun pade
K'o fi ife rado bo o,
K'o pa oro iku fun o,
K' Olorun so o k'a tun pade.
chorus: K' Olorun soo, k'a tun pade.

hymns.title: God be wilh you till we meet again,
verses: 1.God be wilh you till we meet again,
By His counsels guide, uphold you,
With His sheep securely fold you.
God be with you till we meet again:
2.God be with you till we meet again,
God be with you till we meet again
3.God be with you till we meet again
When life's perils thick confound you
Put His arms unfailing round you
God be with you till we meet again.
4.God be with you till we meet again,
Keep love's banner floating o'er you,
God be with you till we meet again.
chorus: Till we meet, till we meet,
Till we meet at Jesus' feet,
Till we meet, till we meet,
God be with you till we meet again

hymns.title: "Aye si nbe!" Ile Od'aguntan
verses: Ewa ogo Re npe o pe maa bo,
2.Ojo lo tan, oorun si fere wo
4.O nkun, o nkun; ile ayo naa nkun!
Yara, yara: ko ti kun ju fun o
Ilekun ife; iwo ko pe ju
6. Wole! wole! Iwo la sase fun
Awon angel' npe o, fun ade
8. Lohun rara nipe ife na ndun
Wa, mase lora; wo 'le ase naa
9. K'ile to su ilekun naa le ti!
'Gbana, o k' abamo! O se! O se!
"Ose! Ose! ko s'aye mo, Ose!". Amin.

hymns.title: "Yet there is room" The Lamb's
verses: 1."Yet there is room" The Lamb's bright hall of song,
With its fair glory, beckons thee along:
Room, room, still room! oh, enter, enter now!
With its fair glory beckons thee along
2.Day is declining, and the sun is low;
The shadows lengthen, light makes haste to go
Room, room, still room! oh, enter, enter now!
The shadows lengthen, light make haste to go
3.The bridal hall is filling for the feast
Pass in! pass in! and be the Bridegroom's guest
Room, room! still room! oh, enter enter now!
Pass in! pass in! and be the Bridegroom's guest
4.Yet there is room! still open stands the gate
The gate of love, it is not yet too late:
Room, room, still room! oh, enter, enter now!
The gate of love, it is not yet too late
5.Pass in! pass in! That banquet is for thee:
That cup of everlasting love is free:
Room, room, still room, oh, enter, enter now!
That cup of everlasting love is free
6.All heav'n is there! all joy! Go in, go in!
The angels beckon thee the prize to win:
Room, room, still room, oh, enter enter now!
The angels beckon thee the prize to win
7.Louder and sweeter sounds the loving call;
Come ling'rer, come! enter that festal hall:
Room, room, still room, oh, enter, enter now!
Come ling'rer, come! enter that festal hall
8.It fills, it fills, that hall of jubilee!
Make haste, make haste! 'tis not too full for thee!
Room, room, still room, oh enter, enter now!
Make haste, make haste! 'tis not too full for thee!
9.Ere night that gate may close and seal thy doom.
Then the last, low, long cry, "No room, no room!
No room, no room! oh, woeful cry! "No room!"
Then the last, low, long cry “No room, No room.

hymns.title: Korin ife 'yanu Jesu
verses: A o lo ri ewa Re
chorus: Ojo ayo giga ni eyi y'o je

hymns.title: Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,
verses: Sing His mercy and His grace,
In the mansions bright and blessed,
He'll prepare for us a place.
Clouds will over spread the sky;
But when travelling days are over;
Not a shadow, not a sigh.
3.Let us then be true and faithful.
Just one glimpse of Him in glory
Will the toils of life repay.
Soon the pearly gates will open,
We shall tread the streets of gold.
chorus: When we all get to heaven,
What a day of rejoicing that will be?
We'll sing and shout the victory.

hymns.title: A nsoro ile 'bukun ni
verses: Y'o ti dun to lati de 'e.
Oso odi re ti ko l'egbe
Y'o ti dun to lati de 'be.
Y'o ti dun to lati de 'be.
Ti a ko le f'orin aye we di
B'o ti wu k'orin wa dun to
Y'o ti dun to lati de 'be.
Y'o ti dun to lati de 'be.
Sa se emi wa ye fun orun
B'o ti dun to lati de 'be. Amin

hymns.title: We speak of the realms of the Blest,
verses: 1.We speak of the realms of the Blest,
Of that country so bright and so fair,
And oft are its glories confess'd:
But what must it be to be there ?
2.We speak of its pathways of gold,
Of its walls deck'd with Jewels most rare
But what must it be to be there ?
3.We speak of its freedom from sin,
But what must it be to be there?
4.We speak of its anthems of praise,
With which we can never compare
The sweetest on earth we can raise:
But what must it be to be there ?
5.We speak of its service of love,
Of the robes which the glorified wear,
The Church of the First-born above,
But What must it be to be there ?
Still for Heav'n our spirit prepare;
And shortly we also shall know
And feel what it is to be there.Amen

hymns.title: Tal’ awon wonyi b'irawo
verses: Ti won si de ade wura
Ti won fife won fun Kristi
won si Y’ara won si mimo
Won wa l'ayo l'odo Re. Amin

hymns.title: Who are these like stars appearing,
verses: These, before God's throne who stand?
Each a golden crown is wearing
Who are all this glorious band?
These, whose robes of purest whiteness
Still untouch'd by time's rude hand?
Whence come all this glorious band?
Wrestling on till life was ended,
These, who well the fight sustained,
Triumph by the Lamb have gained.
4.These are they whose hearts were riven,
Sore with woe and anguish tried
Who in pray'r full oft have striven
God has bid them weep no more,
5.These are they who watch'd and waited
Offering up to Christ their will
Day and night to serve Him still
Now in God's most holy place
Blest they stand before His face. Amen.

hymns.title: Jerusalem on high
verses: Its streets are made of gold
And there is no moon there
We do not need all these
Their long'd for Prince of Peace.
8. Ah me! ah me! that I
No place like this on high;
chorus: O happy place! when shall I be,
My God, with Thee, to see Thy face!

hymns.title: Jerusalem' ile ayo
chorus: Inu wa yoo dun lojo ikeyin
Inu wa yoo dun lojo ikeyin
Gba toluwa ba ka wa mo won

hymns.title: Jerusalem, my happy home,
verses: When shall my labours have an end,
In joy, and peace, and thee?
2.When shall these eyes thy heav'n built walls
Blest seats, through rude and stormy
4.Why should I shrink at pain and woe,
I've Canaan's goodly land in view,
My soul still pants for thee!
Then shall my labours have an end
When I thy joys shall see.Amen.
chorus: We shall be happy on the last day
We shall be happy on the last day
We the Lord shall count us worthy
Joy will fill our entire heart

hymns.title: Ile kan wa to dara julo
verses: Lati file kan fun wa nibe
Emi wa ki o tun kedun mo
A ko ni daro fun 'simi mo
Li awa yoo ma fi iyin fun
N'tor' ebun ife Re t'o logo
Oun bukun t'o ya wa si mimo.
chorus: A o pade l'ebute rere naa.

hymns.title: There's a land that is fairer than day,
verses: 1.There's a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar
For the Father waits over the way,
To prepare us a dwelling place there
2.We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blessed
And our spirit shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessing of rest
We will offer our tribute of praise
For the glorious gift of His love
And the blessing that hallow our days.Amen.
chorus: In the sweet by and by

hymns.title: Ile ewa wonni, bo ti dara to
verses: 1.Ile ewa wonni, bo ti dara to
Ibugbe Otorun, toju ko ti ri
Tal'o fe de 'be, lehin aye yi?
Tal'o fe ka wo oun ni aso funfun?
2.Awon wonni to ji ninu orun won
Awon to ni 'gbagbo si nnkan ta ko ri
Awon ti ko tiju agbelebu Kristi.
3.Awon ti ko naani gbogbo nnkan aye
Awon to le sooto de oju iku
4.Itiju ni fun yin, Om' ogun Jesu
Kinla! e nfi fere at'ilu sire
'Gbat' o ni ke sise, to si pe, “E ja!”
5.B'igbi omi aye si ti nkolu wa,
Jesu Oba Ogo, so si wa l'eti
Adun to wa lorun, ilu mimo ni
Nibiti isimi wa, lae ati laelae.   Amin.

hymns.title: Those eternal bowers man hath never trod,
verses: 1.Those eternal bowers man hath never trod,
Those unfading flowers round the Throne of God;
Who may hope to gain them after weary fight
Who at length attain them, clad in robes of white?
2.He who wakes from slumber at the spirit's voice
Daring here to number things unseen his choice;
He who casts his burden down at Jesus' cross,
Christ's reproach his guerdon, all beside but loss
3.He who gladly barters all on earthly ground;
He who, like the Martyrs, says "I will be crowned;"
He whose one oblation is a life of love.
Knit in God's salvation to the blest above,
4.Shame upon you, legions of the Heavenly King,
What, with pipe and tabor dream away the light,
When He calls to labour and faith's arduous fight?
5.Jesus, Lord of Glory, as we breast the tide,
Whisper Thou the story of the other side;
Where, the Saints are casting crowns before Thy feet,
Safe for everlasting in Thyself complete.

hymns.title: Kukuru lojaye wa
verses: Nibe ni a o ma wa O

hymns.title: Brief life is here our portion;
verses: The life that knows no ending,
But then shall wear the crown
4.But He, whom now we trust in,
Shall then be seen and known:
And they, that know and see Him,
Shall have Him for their own.
Shall shine as doth the day
And worship face to face.     Amen.

hymns.title: Lehin aye buburu yi,
verses: K o s'oru , a f'osan titi,
A ko ni gburo egun mo,
Awon t' a f’ Emi mimo to,
Awon ni o wa nibe.         Amin

hymns.title: When ends earth's long and evil day
verses: 1.When ends earth's long and evil day
This world of mis'ry and of woes
There is a place so bright
No change or decay there to find
No night, but all eternal day
Tell me, will you be there?
2.It's pearly gates are clos'd to sin
No unclean thing shall enter in
To spoil the place so bright,
No curse will ever there be found
Tell me, will you be there?
3.Who will be there the lowly heart?
Who served the Lord in godly fear
Who count the world but loss
Those led by the Holy Spirit
Those who walk in the narrow way,
They are those to be there.     Amen.

hymns.title: I am a stranger here
verses: Its there that I’ll find rest

hymns.title: Gbo, okan mi, bi Angeli ti nkorin
verses: 1.Gbo, okan mi, bi Angeli ti nkorin
E gbo bi oro orin won ti dun to!
Ti nso gbati ese ki y'o si mo;
2.B'a si ti nlo, be l’a si ngbo orin won
Wa, alaare, Jesu lo ni k'e wa,
L'okunkun ni a ngbo orin didun won,
Ohun orin won ni nfonahan wa,
3.Ohun Jesu ni a ngbo l'ona rere,
Ohun naa ndun b'agogo y'aye ka,
Egbegberun awon to ngbo ni si mbo;
Mu won w'odo Re, Olugbala wa
Ile y'o mo, lehin ookun aye;
E ma korin didun ka ba'ma gbo
Tit' ao fi nu omije oju wa nu.
Ti a o si ma yo titi laelae.
Won nkorin ayo pade ero l'ona. Amin
chorus: Won korin ayo pade ero lona.

hymns.title: Hark! hark, my soul; angelic songs are swelling
verses: 1.Hark! hark, my soul; angelic songs are swelling
O'er earth's green fields and ocean's wave-beat shore:
How sweet the truth those blessed strains are telling
Of'that new life when sin shall be no more
2.Onward we go: for still we hear them singing,
Come, weary souls, for Jesus bids you come .
And through the dark its echoes sweetly ringing,
The music of the gospel leads us Home
3.Far, far away, like bells at evening pealing,
The voice of Jesus sounds o'er land and sea,
And laden souls, by thousands meekly stealing,
Kind Shepherd, turn their weary steps to Thee.
4.Rest comes at length: though life be long and dreary
The day must dawn and darksome night be past,
Faith's journey ends in welcome to the weary,
And heav'n the heart's true home, will come at last.
5. Angels, sing on, your faithful watches keeping:
Sing us sweet fragments of the songs above,
'Till morning's joy shall end the night of weeping,
And life's long shadows break in cloudless love.Amen.
chorus: Angels of Jesus, angels of light,
Singing to welcome the pilgrims of the night!

hymns.title: Ma gbadura; Emi Mimo nbebe
verses: Fun aini re ni wakati gbogbo.
Adura nri eje Jes'u ti nsan.
5.Ma gbadura; b'ayo ba yi o ka
Adura nba won mu omi iye.
7.Gbogbo ohun aye; yo ba aye koja

hymns.title: Pray, always pray; the Holy Spirit pleads.
verses: 1.Pray, always pray; the Holy Spirit pleads.
Within thee all thy daily hourly needs
2.Pray, always pray; beneath sin's heaviest load.
Prayer sees the blood from Jesus' side that flow'd
3.Pray, always pray;though weary, faint, and lone.
Prayer nestless by the Father's shelt'ring throne.
4.Pray, always pray; amid the world's tur-moil
Prayer keeps the heart at rest, and nerves for toil.
5.Pray, always pray; if joys thy pathway throng
Prayer strikes the harp and sings the angels' song.
6.Pray, always pray, if loved one pass the veil
Prayer drinks with then of springs that cannot fail.
7.All earthly things with earth shall fade away.
Prayer grasps eternity, pray, always pray.

hymns.title: Aigbagbo bila temi l’Oluwa
verses: On o si dide fun igbala mi
Ki nsa ma gbadura, Oun o se ranwo
'Gba Krist' wa lodo mi, ifoiya ko si.
2.B'ona mi ba su, Oun lo sa nto mi
Ki nsa gboran sa, Oun o si pese
Oro tenu Re so yo bori d'andan.
3.Ife to nfihan ko je ki nro pe
Yo fi mi sile ninu wahala
Iranlowo ti mo si nri lojojumo
O nki mi laya pe, emi o laja.
Tabi irora? O ti so tele.
Won ko le s'akoja larin wahala.
Aye Re tile buru jii temi lo
Jesu ha le jiya, kemi si ma sa.
B'oni tile koro, sa ko ni pe mo
'Gbana orin 'segun yio ti dun to. Amin

hymns.title: With faith in the Lord
verses: For He will arise to deliver us
While Christ is so near us
Only to obey, He will render help

verses: O day of joy and light,
O balm of care and sadness,
On thee, the high and lowly,
The light first had its birth;
Christ rose from depths of earth;
And thus on Thee most glorious
From storms that round us rise;
From this our day of rest;

hymns.title: Ho, my comrades! see the signal
verses: In our leader's name we'll triumph
chorus: Hold the fort, for I am coming!"
Wave the answer back to heaven,

hymns.title: Oluwa gbo adura wa
verses: N'nu le Re l’ojo mimo yi
A o fayo rin lona tayo,
A o si sun ninu Oluwa.

hymns.title: O Lord our God hear Thou our pray'r
verses: 1.O Lord our God hear Thou our pray'r
In this Thy house on this Thy day
2.Sweet is Thy rest, O Lord my God
But there's a greater rest above
Thus our thirsty soul now desire
Nor sin nor death shall reach the place
The voice of pain shall not sound there
The daylight will not be dark there
Dawn on this realms of world of pain
With joy we shall walk path of joy
And sleep in death to rest with Lord. Amen.

verses: K'a sin O bo ti ye

hymns.title: Jesus we love to meet
verses: 2. Let us shake off dull sloth
And may Thou teach us, Lord
Bless all the word we hear
As we part, be with us

hymns.title: Emi ni Alpha ati Omega
verses: Emi si ni eniti o ti ku
Ti mo si nbe laaye titi laelae.
Mo kun aye, Mo kun orun
Eyiti se Oba iye titi lae.
4.E ma beru, eyin Mimo to pe
Agbara otun de fun yin lofe
Otun ni agbara mi titi laelae.
E wa, E wa eyin alabukun
E wa ka fi 'fe korin didun naa
Fun ogo, fun ola, fun iyin Mi
E fayo gberin ogo didan naa
Orin Jesu Oba ogo titi.   Amin

hymns.title: I am the alpha and the Omega
verses: 1. I am the alpha and the Omega
I am the beginning and I’m the end
And I am the one who had died before
And now I remain alive forever
2. I am the one, beside me there’s no one
I’m the King who speaks and brings it to pass
I fill the earth and the heavens
I am the holy one, the lamb of God
3. Holy, Holy is My great glorious name
The King that never dies, never perish
Wonderful is my most powerful name
Which also includes: the ever living King
4. Do not be afraid, you holy people
A new empowerment has been given
I am the Lord God of the new city
And my great power is renewed for ever more
5. I am the Lord God, and I changeth not
O come, o come the blessed and favoured ones
Come, let’s sing the melodious song in love
The song of Moses and that of the Lamb
Is the song sang by the heavenly choir
For my glory, my honour and my praise
For King of the beginning and the end
7. I am the great King of my great prophets
So joyfully resound the glorious song
The song of Jesus, the eternal King.  Amen

hymns.title: This is the day of light
verses: O Day-spring, rise upon our night,
On weary brain and troubled breast
Bid Thou the blasts of discord cease,
The waves of strife be fill
Let earth to heav'n draw near,
Lift up our hearts to seek Thee there,
Come down to meet us here.
And wake dead souls to love and praise,

hymns.title: Kinni 'simi ayo ailopin ni
verses: T’ awon angeli at' awon mimo ni
Nibe, Olorun nikan ni won nsin.

hymns.title: What are those sabbaths of joy without end,
verses: 1.What are those sabbaths of joy without end,
Angels in light and the glorified spend:
Rest for the weary; for victors reward;
There God Himself all and in all adored?
2.Who is the Monarch? who circle His throne?
What is the calm restful bliss of His own?
Tell us, ye blessed ones worshipping there,
Tell us, if words can your rapture declare.
Whose perfect peace is eternal delight
Longing in thee are fulfill'd, ere express'd:
More than was long'd for embraced and possess.
4.Troubles all past, in the courts of our King
We without fear Zion's anthems shall sing,
Off’ring Thee, Lord, in Thy presence above
Love's pure responses for gifts of Thy love.
5.There never Sabbath to Sabbath give place:
One is their Sabbath who gaze on Thy face.
There never cease heaven's jubilee songs,
Chanted by saints and by sweet angel tongues.
6.Meantime in heart and with faith-winged prayers
Seek we our Fatherland yonder and theirs.
While to Jerusalem bounden we roam,
Of whom and through whom and in whom are all;
Of whom the Father, and through whom the Son,
In whom the spirit of Both, ever One.

hymns.title: Ose Ose rere
verses: O ye ka fi ojo kan

hymns.title: Holy, Holy Sabbath,
verses: We ought to make up one day,
We shall forsake all our works
So lovely as thou art to us,
Give to thy maker one day
Out of the six you have;
To Church ye all must go;
Must go to house of prayer.
I love to see thy gate;
A sign of heaven I know thou art,
O! Lord make me a Heir to
Thy throne at end of life;
To reign with thee for ever,
With Bright and Morning Star.  Amen.

hymns.title: Didun ni se na, Oba mi
verses: Lala ko si fun mi loni
Ise rere Re ti po to
Ti ayo pupo si ba mi
5.Gbana ngo ri ngo gbo, ngo mo
Ohun gbogbo ti mo ti nfe
Lati se ife Re titi. Amin

hymns.title: Sweet is the work, my God my King
verses: 1.Sweet is the work, my God my King
To praise Thy name, give thanks and Sing
To show Thy love by morning light,
And talk of all Thy truth at night.
2.Sweet is the day of sacred rest,
No mortal cares disturb my breast,
O may my heart in tune be found,
Like David's harp of solemn sound!
3.My heart shall triumph in the Lord,
And bless His works and bless His word;
Thy works of grace, how bright they shine!
How deep Thy counsels, how divine!
4. And I shall share a glorious part
When grace has well refined my heart,
And fresh supplies of joy are shed,
Like holy oil, to cheer my head.
5.Then shall I see, and hear, and know,
All I desired or wish'd below;
And every pow'r find sweet employ
In that eternal world of joy.  Amen.

hymns.title: Eyi l'ojo t'Oluwa da
verses: K'orun ko yo kaye k'o yo
Yio dun ju be lo. Amin

hymns.title: This is the day the Lord hath made,
verses: 1.This is the day the Lord hath made,
He call the hours His own;
Let Heav'n rejoice, let earth be glad,
2.Today He rose and left the dead,
Today the saints His triumphs spread,
Help us, O Lord! descend and bring
4.Bless'd be the Lord, who comes to men
Who comes, in God His Father's Name
The Church on earth can raise;
The highest Heav'ns, in which He reigns,
Shall give Him nobler praise. Amen

hymns.title: Mimo, Mimo, Mimo, Olodumare
verses: Ni kutukutu n'lwo'o gbo orin wa

3.Mimo, Mimo, Mimo, b'ikuku pa O mo

Iwo nikan l'O mo, ko tun s'elomiran
Gbogbo ise Re n'ile loke lo nyin O

hymns.title: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty!
verses: Early in the morning our song shall rise to the
Holy, holy, holy merciful and mighty,
God in Three Persons, blessed Trinity
2.Holy, holy, holy all the saints adore Thee,
Casting down their golden crowns around the glassy sea;
Cherubim and Seraphim falling down before Thee,
Which wert and art, and evermore shalt be.
3.Holy, holy, holy! though the darkness hide Thee,
Though the eye of sinful man Thy glory may not see,
Only thou art holy there is none beside Thee,
Perfect in pow'r, in love, and purity.
4. Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty
All Thy works shall praise Thy
name in earth and sky and sea;
Holy, holy, holy, merciful and mighty,
God in Three persons, blessed Trinity!

hymns.title: Great shepherd of thy people hear
verses: As Thou hast giv'n a place for pray'r
So give us hearts to pray.
2.Show us some token of thy love
And pour thy blessing from above
Here give the trouble conscience ease
And shine upon us from on high,
That we in grace may grow.
5.May we in faith receive Thy word,
And in the presence of our Lord

hymns.title: Nigbawo, Olugbala mi
verses: Se mi ki nf’ ife gbadura
3.Da mi si, Baba, da mi si
Gba ohun gbogbo ti mo ni

hymns.title: At what time and moment, my Lord
verses: 1. At what time and moment, my Lord
2. O help me in all my wandering
Help me be prayerful in love
And do take all my possessions
Then give me your own self
4. Father, give me of your spirit
And be the light unto my feet

hymns.title: Oluwa ojo isimi
verses: Gba orin iyin ti a nko

Ese tab' egbe ki yoo o de ‘be,

A fe yo! lona ise yi

hymns.title: Lord of the Sabbath, hear our vows,
verses: 1.Lord of the Sabbath, hear our vows,
On this thy day, in this thy house;
The songs which from thy servants rise.
But there's a nobler rest above;
To that our lab'ring souls aspire
With ardent hope and  strong desire,
Nor sin nor hell, shall reach the place;
No sighs shall mingle with the songs
No cares to break the long response,
No midnight shade, no clouded sun;
Dawn on these realms of woe and sin;
Faint would we leave this weary road.
And sleep in death, to rest with God

hymns.title: A be, a fe ri o
How our hearts long for Thee
verses: All the week long, we long for Thee,
Christ rose up from the dead,
All the week long, we long for Thee,
All the week long, we long for Thee
The blessing of the holy men
Thou hallowed day of rest.  Amen

hymns.title: Akoko odun at'osu
verses: B’o ti ye ni ki a se

hymns.title: All times and seasons, months and
verses: Day is given for us to work
But the night is meant for sleep,
2.He also made a day of rest
Out of sev'n days He gave one,
So that man may have a whole day,
3.Six days there are in which to work
Let us do it as we ought
On the seventh, let us gather,
In God's house to worship there.
4. On this day, we all meet to pray,
And we sing our songs to Him
We praise and glorify our God
Who is the greatest of all.
5.Now let us lift high our praises
The praises of our Lord God,
Raise the anthem, swell the music
In sweet praises of our God.    Amen.

verses: Da nnkan gbogbo ti nbe laye

hymns.title: Our God who art in heav'n
verses: But for those who will not obey
After our six days of labour,
We ought to rest in it
Assembled are we in Thy house,
O Jesus Lord, Thou blessed Son
Lead us unto Thy rest.   Amen

verses: K'o le fa inu didun wa,

B'o ti dun lati l’ojo yi

hymns.title: Six days of work and toil are past
verses: 1.Six days of work and toil are past
This one begun, is meant for rest
Come thou my heart, and take thine rest
Rejoice thou in the day God bless'd,
2.Let all our thoughts and praises rise
Like sweet incense unto Thy throne
That it may bring down joy untold
Known only to those made holy.
3.This heav'nly peace of heart is giv'n
As witness of a glorious rest,
To the ones who have been made pure,
The end of afflictions and cares.
4.O Lord, we rejoice at Thy work
In various huts, both new and old
We praise Thee, Lord, for mercy giv'n
In earnest hope of that to come,
5. Give us sweet holy sleep at night
Also have great delight in it
It is so sweet to spend the day
With hope of one that never ends. Amen.

hymns.title: Give to the winds thy fears:
verses: God hear thy sighs, and counts thy
tears, God shall lift up thy head.
Wait thou His time; so shall this night
Our hearts are known to Thee:
O lift Thou up the sinking hand
And publish with our latest breath
Thy love and guardian care. Amen

hymns.title: Let your blessing abide with us
verses: Let your blessing fill our hearts
Let each person experience Your love
And have joy in your blessings
And have joy in your blessings
And have joy in your blessings
Give us more of your great grace
Our Saviour, keep going with us
Let’s have joy in your blessing
Give to us your soothing peace

Holy Son keep going with us
Let your power rest on us
Let your blessing rest on us
Let your blessing rest on us.      Amen

hymns.title: Draw nigh and take the Body of the
verses: 1.Draw nigh and take the Body of the Lord,
And drink the holy Blood for you out-poured.
2.Saved by His Body, hallowed by His Blood,
With souls refreshed we render thanks to God.
3. Offer'd was He for greatest and for least,
Himself the Victim and Himself the Priest.
By His dear Cross and Blood the vict'ry won.
5. All the past sacrifices of the Jews
Serve as example for this Sacrifice.
6. He; Ransomer from death, and Light from shade,
Now gives His Holy grace His saints to aid.
7. Approach ye then with faithful hearts sincere,
And take the pledges of Salvation here.
8.He, that in this world rules His saints, and shields,
To all believers life eternal yields.
9.With Heav'nly Bread makes them that hunger whole,
Gives Living Waters to the thirsting Soul
10.O Judge of all, our only Saviour Thou,
In this Thy least of love be with us now.

My bread from heaven shall be;
4.When to the cross I turn mine eyes,
O lamb of God, my sacrifice,
And all, thy love to me;
Yea, while a breath, a pulse remains,
6.And when these failing lips grow dumb,
When thou shall in thy Kingdom come,

verses: Je k'a mo p'o sunmo wa;

verses: To Thy table now lead us
With the true and heav'nly bread
Thy sweet presence let us feel
3.While we gaze on Thee with faith
Of Thine out poured blood the sign.
Fill our hearts Lord, with Thy love,
Whence there flowed the healing tide
There all sins and sorrows hide
Lamb of God, grant us Thy peace.
7.Lead us on with Thy pierced hand
Till we reach Thy throne above
In the bright and better land.   Amen.

hymns.title: Farahan wa nibi ounje

verses: 1.Be known to us in breaking bread,
Saviour, abide with us, and spread

That living bread, that heav'nly wine,

Ogbe Re lo wo mi san
Jeki nma gbe inu Re. Amin

hymns.title: Bread of Heav’n on Thee we feed,
verses: 1. Bread of Heav’n on Thee we feed,
For Thy flesh is meat indeed:
Ever may our souls be fed
With this true and living Bread;
Day by day with strength supplied,
Through the life of Him Who died.
2. Vine of Heav’n, Thy blood supplies
Lord, Thy wounds our healing give,
To Thy cross we look and live:
Grafted, rooted, built in Thee.  Amen.

hymns.title: Sweet feast of love divine
verses: Tis grace that makes us free
To feed upon this bread and wine
Waits, Lord from thee to learn
The secrets of thy Father's breast
The sweetness of the bread of life
And fell the blesse'd pledge within
That we are loved of Thee.
what will it be,O Lord, above

hymns.title: Ounje araye ta faanu bu
verses: Tiku Re pa ese wa run.

Or-ofe Re ta fi nbo wa. Amin

hymns.title: Earthly food served with tender mercy
verses: 1. Earthly food served with tender mercy
The One that spoke out the living word
Whose death cleansed us of all our sins
2. Look upon the heart full of sorrow
Look at the tears of the sinner
Let your word become an example
Of your sweet grace that sustains us.  Amen.

verses: Fun mi je ki nle ye

hymns.title: Break Thou the bread of life,
verses: As Thou didst break the loaves
Beside the sea: Beyond the sacred place
Given me to eat and live
Teach me to love Thy truth
That He may touch my eyes,

hymns.title: Come, the order is made
verses: Come to the food of life
That the door might not shut
And the Lord spoke to them
chorus: Come to the place of wine
Trust in Him here on earth

hymns.title: Oluwa mi mo npade Re nihin
verses: Mo nfi gbagbo woke sile orun
Ngo fi agbara ro mo oro Re
Ngo si fi ara are mi ti O
Emi o mu waini orun peju Re
Nihin ngo so eru aye kale
3.Emi ko ni ranwo mi lehin Re

6.Bi ase yi ti nde ti o si nlo

hymns.title: Here, O my Lord, I see Thee face to
verses: 1.Here, O my Lord, I see Thee face to face;
Here would I touch and handle things unseen,
Here grasp with firmer hand the eternal grace,
And all my weariness upon Thee lean
2.Here would I feed upon the bread of God
Here drink with Thee the royal wine of heav'n
Here would I lay aside each earthly load,
Here taste afresh the calm of sin Forgiven
3.I have no help but Thine; nor do I need
Another arm save Thee lean upon;
It is enough, my Lord, enough indeed;
My strength is in Thy might, Thy might alone.
4.Mine is the sin, but thine the righteousness;
Mine is the guilt, but Thine the cleansing-blood;
Here is my robe, my refuge, and my peace
Thy blood, Thy righteousness, O Lord, my God.
5.Too soon we rise; the symbols disappear;
The feast, though not the love, is passed and gone
The bread and wine remove, but Thou art there-
Nearer than ever-still my shield and sun.
6.Feast after feast thus comes and passes by.
Yet, passing, point to the glad feast above,
O Giving sweet foretaste of the festal joy;
The Lamb's great bridal feast of bliss and love.Amen

hymns.title: Wa eyin olope wa
verses: Ni jo naa yoo gba gbogbo

hymns.title: Come, ye thankful people, come,
verses: Raise the song of harvest home:
For our wants to be supplied:
Come to God's own temple, come,
Raise the song of harvest home!
Fruit unto His praise to yield;
First the blade, and then the ear,
Then the full corn shall appear
Grant, O harvest Lord, that we
Wholesome grain and pure may be
3.For the Lord our God shall come,
And shall take His harvest home:
From His field shall in that day
Give His angels charge at last
In the fire the tares to cast;
But the fruitful ears to store
Raise the song of harvest home:
Free from sorrow, free from sin
Raise the glorious harvest home! Amen.

hymns.title: Oluwa kore Wo la yin
verses: Je kiyin gba okan wa kan.
'Wo gba wa la o ma yin
Beda ti nko ire won jo
Awa pelu yoo maa yin O
Oore Re ni gbogbo wa npin.
Ojo ti nro, orun ti nran
Otun n'iyin Re lenu wa. Amin

hymns.title: Lord of the harvest, Thee we hail,
verses: 1.Lord of the harvest, Thee we hail,
Thine ancient promise doth not fail
The varying seasons haste their round
With goodness all our years are crown'd
Our thanks we pay This holy day;
Oh let our hearts in tune be found.
2.If spring doth wake the song of mirth;
If summer warms the fruitful earth;
When winter sweeps the naked plain,
Or autumn yields its ripen'd grain
Still do we sing to Thee, our King;
Through all their changes Thou dost reign.
Scatters new plenty o'er the land,
When sounds of music fill the air,
As homeward all their treasures bear
We too will raise our hymn of praise,
For we Thy common bounties share,
4.Lord of the harvest, all is Thine
The rains that fall, the suns that shine
The seed once hidden in the ground,
Thy skill that makes our fruits abound;
New every year Thy gifts appear;
New praises from our lips shall sound.

hymns.title: Yin Olorun Oba wa;
verses: O mu ki aka wa kun;

hymns.title: Praise, O praise our God and King!
verses: 1. Praise, O praise our God and King!
2. Praise Him that He made the sun
Day by day his course to run;
4.Praise Him that He gave the rain
He hath filled the garner floor;
And blest Spirit, Three in One. Amen.

hymns.title: Oluwa a gbe okan wa
verses: A mebo ope wa fun O
To bee ti won fi nkorin.
Ti oun yoo to si aba.
Ti a o ma ko titi.   Amin

hymns.title: To Thee, O Lord, our hearts we raise
verses: 1. To Thee, O Lord, our hearts we raise
To Thee bring sacrifice of praise
Bright robes of gold the fields adorn,
The hills with joy are ringing,
The valleys stand so thick with corn
2.And now, on this our festal day,
By Thee the souls of men are fed
Thou who dost give us earthly bread
3.We hear the burden of the day,
But labour ends with sunset ray,
And rest comes for the weary:
4.O blessed is that land of God
Where golden fields spread far and broad
The strains of all its holy throng;
Thrice blessed is that harvest song
Which never hath an ending.  Amen

hymns.title: Okan mi, a tun fi Jesu lo o
verses: 1.Okan mi, a tun fi Jesu lo o
Kristi Iwo li emi o gbagbo
'Wo nikan lo le fun mi lagbara
Ki gbogbo wa so tokan tokan pe
5.Awon to to O wa nigba aye Re
"Mo fe" ni idahun ti won ri gba
chorus: Eje Re 'yebiye lo fi ra mi.

hymns.title: Once more, my soul, thy savior thro' the Word.
verses: 1.Once more, my soul, thy savior thro' the Word.
And now, O Lord, I must. I must decide:
2.By grace I will Thy mercy now receive,
Thy love my heart hath won;
On Thee, O Christ, I will, I will believe,
3. Thou knowest, Lord, how very weak I am
And how I fear to stray;
For strength to serve I look to Thee alone
4.And now, O Lord, give all with us today
The grace to join our song
And from the heart to gladly with
us say; "I will to Christ belong!
5.To all who came, when Thou wast here below
To them, "I will!" was ever Thy reply:
We rest upon it now. Amen.
chorus: I will! O Lord, be Thine!
Thy precious blood was shed to purchase me.

hymns.title: Oluwa kore sokale
verses: Gba ope wa, sure fun wa

hymns.title: May the Lord of harvest come down
verses: 1. May the Lord of harvest come down
And come and bless this home
And come to us with your blessing
2. May the Lord of harvest come down
And with a multitude of your grace
3. May the Lord of harvest come down
Come and spare us from all the guilt
From our sins and from our shame
4. May the Lord of harvest come down
Receive our thanks, and bless us all
5. O bless the house from which we come
From this day of the harvest
And do not leave us in our problems
6. And Lord, bless this your church today
The church of the people of God
Let love take deep roots in us all
