Praise Him, the people of heaven
Praise the Father, Son and Spirit. Amen

hymns.title: Pass me not O gentle savior
verses: While on others Thou art calling,
2.Let me at a throne of mercy
4.Thou the spring of all my comfort,
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
chorus: Saviour! Saviour! Hear my humble cry
And While on others art calling,

hymns.title: To mi, Oluwa, lona ododo Re
verses: 1. To mi, Oluwa, lona ododo Re
Mu ona Re to niwaju mi
L'o le mu mi wa ni ailewu. Amin

hymns.title: Guide me, O Lord, along Your Righteous Path
verses: 1. Guide me, O Lord, along Your Righteous Path
Make Your way perfect in front of me
Because You alone, the One and only Lord
Can make me to be without danger. Amen

hymns.title: Baba a fara wa
verses: Dabobo wa, ko pa wa mo
Titi ile o fi mo. Amin.

hymns.title: Father we commit ourselves
verses: Protect us Lord and keep us safe
Till the sun rise again.    Amen

hymns.title: Ajaga Re ro, eru Re fuye
verses: 1. Ajaga Re ro, eru Re fuye
Mo ti ri be, Mo ti ri be
O nto mi ni osan at'oru

hymns.title: Your yoke is easy, Your burden is light
verses: 1. Your yoke is easy, Your burden is light
I can see it, I can see it
It is guiding me by day and night

hymns.title: Mo f'emi mi sabe
verses: Ki nni gbogbo mi ninu Re

hymns.title: My spirit on Thy care,
verses: Thou will not leave me in despair,
I  know Thee good, I know Thee just,
And count Thy choice the best.
Safe in Thy breast my head I hide,
It must be good for me,
Secure of having Thee in all,
Of having all in Thee  Amen.

hymns.title: Wa, Jesu fi ara han
verses: Wa, je, k'okan wa mo O
Wa, bukun wa k'a to lo.
Wa, ko wa b'a ti bebe,

hymns.title: Come, Jesus reveal Thyself
verses: Come, our hearts teach to know Thee
Come, and set our hearts on fire
Come, and bless us ere we part
Come, that we all may be Mewed
Come, and speak the words of peace,
Come, our faith increase. O Lord.
Come, and teach us how to pray,
Come, and fill our hearts with love,
Come, and full our hearts to heaven,
Come, and say ‘You are my choice”
Come, Thy fold in safely keep
Come, and bless Thy sheep today.Amen.

hymns.title: Mo fe ki ndabi Jesu
verses: Bi won ti korira Re to
Ka le wi nipa temi pe
O se won to le se.
Se mi ki ndabi Re.   Amin

hymns.title: I want to be like Jesus,
verses: For no one marked an angry word
So that of me it may be said
Grace, And make me like to Thee.Amen.

hymns.title: Jesu fe mi mo mo be.
verses: Yo tite Re wa so mi.
Ti mi ni gbogbo ona mi
Yo mu mi re 'le orun. Amin

hymns.title: Jesus loves me, this I know,
verses: 1. Jesus loves me, this I know,
For the Bible tells me so;
They are weak, but He is strong,
He will wash away my sin,
Let His little child come in
Though I'm very weak and ill;
From His shining throne on high
He will watch me where I lie.
Close beside me all the way,
Then His little child will take
Up to Heav'n, for His dear sake. Amen.

hymns.title: Bi osun gbege eti 'do
verses: Oba ti ki pa ipo da
Pa wa mo b'omo Re. Amin

hymns.title: By cool Siloam's shady rill
verses: How sweet the breath, beneath the hill,
2.Lo! such the child whose early feet
The paths of peace have trod,
Whose secret heart with influence sweet
The rose that blooms beneath the hill
4.O Thou whose infant feel were found
In childhood, manhood, age and death,
To keep us still Thine own.  Amen.

hymns.title: "Fe enikeji re"
verses: O ko wa pe k'a f'ota wa
O ye ki gbogbo wa mura
Pelu gbogb' eni yi o ka
O si sure fun won. Amin

hymns.title: “Love him who's thy neighbour"
verses: By the way He loved us.
He taught us to love all our foes,
So, all of us ought to prepare
Those that are in your neighbourhood
And blessed and prayed for them

hymns.title: Enikan nbe, t'o feran wa
verses: If e Re, ju ti yekan lo
Sugbon ore yi ko ntan ni
2.Iye ni fun wa, ba ba mo
Ro ba ti je, ni gbese to
Eje Re, lo si fi ra wa
Nin' aginju lo wa wa ri
O si mu wa wa sagbo Re
O fe lati ma bukun wa
Okan wa fe gbo ohun Re,
Oun naa ko si ni tan wa je,
Oun o le ota wa sehin
Ire la o ma ri titi
Oun o fi mu wa lo sogo

hymns.title: One there is above all others,
verses: His is love beyond a brother's,
Earthly friends may fail or leave us,
One day soothe, the next day grieve us
But this Friend will ne'er deceive us
Think O think how much we owe Him.
With His precious Blood He bought us
In the wilderness He sought us,
To His fold He safely brought us
3.We have found a friend in Jesus,
'Tis His great delight to bless us,
How our hearts delight to hear Him
Bid us dwell in safety near Him;
Why should we distrust or fear Him
Backward shall our foes be driven.
Best of blessings He'll provide us,
Nought hut good shall e'er betide us,
Safe lo glory He will guide us,

hymns.title: Ore bi Jesu ko si laye yi
verses: 1.Ore bi Jesu ko si laye yi
Ore aye yi le ko wa sile,
Sugbon Jesu ko je gbagbe mi
Ohunkohun to wu ko le de
Gbati o ro pin 'ranwo Re yo de
Awawi kan ko si lojo na
O daju pe ko je gbagbe mi
Ogo si ni fun Emi Mimo
O daju pe ko je gbagbe mi
chorus: Sugbon Jesu ko je gbagbe mi.

hymns.title: There is no Friend like
verses: Jesus is the only sincere Friend
But the Lord will never forget us
2.Now, wait on the Lord never doubt again
What ever now may betideth thee
Our Lord Jesus is wonderful King
3.Not caring for foes, the time is passing
Drawing near to our home day by day
There will be no excuse on that day.
4. All you members of the native choir
And all the members of the choir
The great Saviour comes to give out rewards
It is sure He’ll never forget us
5. Glory to Father, glory to the Son
And all glory to the Holy Ghost
We will give glory to the Trinity
It is sure He’ll never forget us
chorus: But the lord will never forget us

hymns.title: Ona kan lo ntoka sorun
verses: Mo si mo pe lati dese,

hymns.title: There is a path that leads to God,
verses: 1.There is a path that leads to God,
Narrow but pleasant is the road,
2.It leads straight through this work of sin,
But those who boldly walk therein
Will get to heav'n at last
3. How shall an infant pilgrim dare
For on the way's many a snare
thousands go, Lies near and opens fair;
And many turn aside, I know,
5.But lest my feeble steps should slide,
Lord, condescend to be my guide,
And trust His word of old
"The lambs, He’ll gather with His arm,
And lead them to the fold."
And keep the gate of heav'n in view,
Till I shall enter there.   Amen

hymns.title: 'Gbati Samueli ji
verses: Ngo sa fese to kere ju
N'nu iwe na ni mo ka pe
O ye keru ese ba mi
'Gba mo ba si wa n'ile Re

hymns.title: When little Samuel woke
verses: Oh, blessed happy child to find
The God of heav'n so near and kind
And say He is my Friend
The smallest sin I then should fear
If God Almighty were so near.
Oh, yes, for in His word
He bids me come and seek
In almost ev'ry page I see
The God of Samuel calls to me
I know that God is there
And every sin I well may fear
The voice that I have heard
And when I in Thy house appear
Speak for Thy servant waits to hear.

hymns.title: Gb'ohun Ope soke
verses: Ona iye to pe ni yi
T'o mu wa ri odun yi
A o se t'odun to nbo

hymns.title: Lift up your voice of Praise
verses: The One who kept His church secure
Till this year we are in
Yet the bush is not consumed
Through all the troubles and problems
The work of God goes on
Who God calls into this path
This is the path to salvation
But if we can endure it all
The end will bring us joy
Who spares us till this year
In the name of Jesus our Lord
Are here by His grace alone
May the blessing of this moment
Go with us as we leave
Let’s clap our hands, let’s leap for joy

hymns.title: Omode, e sunm' Olorun
verses: Mu wa kun fun ope si O
Ati ba ti nrin lo laye
K'a ma ri opo aanu gba.
Fi agbara Tire, gba wa. Amin

hymns.title: Ye little ones keep close to God
verses: 1.Ye little ones keep close to God
Let all knees bow down before Him,
Our Lord and Saviour and our friend
Fill us with gratitude to Thee
And in our pilgrimage on earth
May we receive more of Thy grace.
Be far away flung from our hearts,
And each day, give us Thy wisdom
To choose to walk the narrow way.
4.In times of sickness and good health,
In times of plenty or in need,
And when the hour of death shall come
Deliver us with Thy great pow'r Amen.

hymns.title: Wa ba wa jeun Oluwa,
verses: Je k'a ma yin oruko Re;
Wa busi wa ounje wa; si je,
K'a le ba O jeun l'orun. Amin

hymns.title: Be present at our table, Lord,
verses: Bless these Thy gifts and grant that we
May feast in Paradise with Thee.

hymns.title: We thank Thee, Lord, for this our food,
verses: 1.We thank Thee, Lord, for this our food,
For life, and health, and every good,
May manna to our souls he given,
The bread of life sent down from heaven.

hymns.title: Jesu Iwo Ore ewe
verses: Fa mi lowo, ki nba O rin
2.Fi ohun ti nba fe han mi
Ki nma ba se sare wo nu
Ki nma gbon si, ki nma tagun
6.Ma fi mi le, si ko mi

hymns.title: Jesus, You the friend of children
verses: 1. Jesus, You the friend of children
Take my hands, let me walk with you
2. Reveal to me what I should love
So that I won’t make haste to
3. Let my good heart abound with good
You were a child before, because of this
4. Oh Lord, fill my heart with meekness
Let me shine like the shining lamp
I love you from start till the end

hymns.title: Jesu feran awon omode
verses: O gbe won sese Re ri
O gba won mora, O wipe
E jeki won wa sodo Mi.
Ki won ma pe oun ni Jesu
Bi won ko ba pe sire.
Yo mu won lo sorun rere
Yo di won mu, yo ma sin won
Ki won pase obi won mo
6.'Gbati yo ba si wa pe won
Won o ba won ogun orun
Yin ife oun oore Re. Amin

hymns.title: Jesus loves all the little children
verses: 1. Jesus loves all the little children
He carries them on his lap
Let the children come unto Me.
2. It gladdens your heart to see them
As they all kneel down to pray
That they may know that he is Jesus
If they do not know before
3. He redeemed them with his own life
And He will take them to heaven
4. If they accept Him as their Lord
He will wash away their sins
He will hold them, he will guide them
5. He wants them to love each other
Keep the commands of their parents
As He did when he was young
6. And when He shall call all of them
They shall join the host of heaven
Praise His love and his goodness.  Amen.

hymns.title: Wa sodo Jesu, mase duro
verses: Loro Re l'O ti fona han wa
O duro li arin wa loni
Je, k'okan gbogbo kun fun ayo,
K'a si yan Jesu layanfe wa
Feti sofin Re, ko si pamo;
Gbo b'ohun Re ti nwi pele pe-
chorus: Ipade wa yi o je, ayo
Gb'okan wa ba bo lowo ese
Ta o si wa pelu Re, Jesu

hymns.title: Come to the Saviour make no delay;
verses: 1.Come to the Saviour make no delay;
Here in His word He has shown us the way;
Here in our midst He's standing today.
2."Suffer the children!" Oh, hear His voice!
Let ev'ry heart leap forth and rejoice.
And let us freely make Him our choice
3. Think once again. He's with us today:
Heed now His blest command, and obey,
Hear now His accents tenderly say,
Will you, my children, come?  Amen.
chorus: Joyful, joyful, wilt the meeting be
When from sin our hearts are pure and free;
And we shall gather, Saviour with Thee.

hymns.title: Ewe ti Oba orun
verses: Ao si maa ba o lo. Amin.

hymns.title: Children of the heav'nly king,
verses: Glorious in His works and way.
In the way the fathers trod;
They are happy now, and we
You on Jesus' throne shall rest;
There your seat is now prepared,
4.Lift your eyes, ye sons of light;
There our endless home shall be,
There our Lord we soon shall see,
On the borders of your land;
And we still will follow Thee. Amen

hymns.title: Baba wa ti mbe li orun
Our Father, who art in heaven,
verses: On earth as it is in heaven.
2.Give us this day our daily bread,
As we forgive those who trespass against us.
And the power and the glory Forever.

hymns.title: Wa ma sise
verses: Kaluku ni Baba pase fun pe
Gba pe giga ti angeli ko ni
Ra gba pada, wawa lakoko nlo
Oko po alagbase ko si to
A nibi titun gba a ni po ro
Ko si alailera ti ko le se nkan
Ailera l'Olorun a ma lo ju
Simi ko si nigbat' ise osan
Titi oorun yio fi wo lale
Ti awa o si gbo ohun ni pe
Laalaa na'dun, ere re si daju
Bukun f’awon to fori ti dopin
Ayo won, simi won yo ti po to

hymns.title: Come, labour on!
verses: Who dares stand idle on the harvest plain,
While all around him waves the golden grain?
And to each servant does the Master say,
Claim the high calling Angels cannot share,
To young and old the Gospel-gladness bear;
Redeem the time: its hours too swiftly fly,
The enemy is watching night and day
To sow the lean, to snatch the seed away;
While we in sleep our duty have forgot,
Away with gloomy doubts and faithless fear!
No arm so weak but may do service here,
By feeblest agents can our God fulfil
No time for rest, till glows the western sky,
Till the long shadows o'er our pathway lie,
And a glad sound comes with the setting sun
The toil is pleasant, the reward is sure,
Blessed are those who to the end endure;
How full their joy, how deep their rest shall be,

hymns.title: Jesu npe wa losan loru
verses: Ka fe O ju aye lo. Amin.

hymns.title: Jesus calls us! O'er the tumult
verses: Of our life's wild restless sea,
Day by day His sweet voice soundeth,
Turned from home and toil and
Leaving all for His dear sake,
Of the vain world's golden store,
From each idol that would keep us,
4.In our joys and in our sorrows,
Days of toil and hours of ease,
Still He calls, in cares and pleasures,
That we love Him more than these.
Saviour, make us hear Thy call,
Give our hearts to Thine obedience,
Serve and love Thee best of all. Amen.

hymns.title: Mo fara Mi fun O
verses: Mo lo opo dun fun o
O lo kan fun Mi bi?
Si f’ara re fun Mi     Amin.

hymns.title: I gave My life for Thee,
verses: I gave My life for thee;
What hast thou giv'n for Me?
I spent long years for thee;
Hast thou spent one for Me?
I left it all for thee;
Hast Thou left aught for Me?
More than thy tongue can tell
What canst thou bear for Me?
Great gifts, I brought to thee;
What hast thou brought to Me?
Thy years for Me be spent,

hymns.title: Jesu mo gbagbelebu mi
verses: Ki nle ma to O lehin
Yo mu mi sunmo O ni
Bife Re ba wa fun mi
Ayo ko si le dun mo mi
Ro t'Emi to wa ninu re

hymns.title: Jesus, I my cross have taken,
verses: All to leave, and follow Thee;
Thou from hence my all shall be:
All I've sought, or hop'd or known,
Yet how rich is my condition!
God and Heav'n art still my own!
Twill but drive me to Thy breast;
Life with trials, hard may press me,
Heav'n will bring me sweeter rest!
Oh! 'tis not in grief to harm me,
While Thy love is left to me!
Oh! 'twere not in joy to charm me,
Were that joy unmixed with Thee!
Rise o'er sin and fear and care;
Joy to find in every station,
Something still to do or bear,
Think what Spirit dwells within thee!
What a Father's smile is thine!
What a Saviour died to win thee!
Child of Heav'n, shouldest thou repine?
4.Haste then on from grace to glory,
Arm'd by faith, and wing'd by pray'r,
God's own Hand shall guide thee there!
Soon shall close thy earthly mission,
Swift shall pass thy pilgrim days,
Hope soon change to glad fruition,
Faith to sight, and pray'r to praise.Amen

hymns.title: Go for the work of God
verses: Go preach the gospel of God
This is the time for mercy
This is the time for salvation
Let us all go forth and work
The Saviour has sent you forth
Go and set the captives free
Jesus Christ has sent you forth
In the mighty name of God
The pow’r of the world is destroyed
chorus: Let us all go forth and work

hymns.title: Oluwa je ki nba O rin
verses: Ko mi lati mu won pada
3.Fun mi ni suru ki nle fi
Oluwa je ki nba o gbe.   Amin.

hymns.title: O Lord God, let me walk with you
verses: 1. O Lord God, let me walk with you
Tell me the secret of your work
How we can overcome all woes
2. And please help me so that I can preach
And win back those that have backslid
So teach me how to bring them back
Those who forsake the path to life
3. Lord, give me the patience to be
Able to gently do your work
Let me draw close to you tightly
4. In the hope that shines radiantly
The light unto the path of life
Give me your sweet and lasting peace
O Lord, let me abide with you.   Amen.

hymns.title: Iranse Oluwa
verses: Bo ba kuku ti kan lekun

hymns.title: Ye servants of the Lord
verses: Gird up your loins, as in His sight,
And while we speak, He’s near;
Mark the first signal of His hand,
He shall his Lord with rapture see,
And raise that faithful servant’s head

hymns.title: Jesu jiya die le kan mi
verses: A kan lese, a gba loju
Die le kan mi bi iwo
Nwo wa bi awa na ti nja
Die le kan mi bi iwo
Die le kan mi bi iwo
Ni yoo gb'Ade ogo didan. Amin

hymns.title: Jesus suffered, and so may I
verses: 1. Jesus suffered, and so may I
Since I want to glory in Him
Why should I cry when troubles come
It's he who suffers that can reign
For me He was nailed to the cross
His feet was nailed and He was slapped
Because of sinners just like me
3. Jesus suffered, and so may I
In all the insult and mocking
In all the troubles of this world
Help me to endure till the end
4. Jesus suffered, and so may I
I may suffer, so might you
The holy ones who have conquered
They come as we fight our battle
5. The holy prophets of the time
I may suffer, so might you
We should endure it till the end
6. The holy apostles of the time
I may suffer, so might you
Help us endure till the end
7. The end of time is my last blessing
God the great king of glory
He who endures all till the end
Shall receive the crown of glory.   Amen.

hymns.title: Gba aye mi, Oluwa
verses: Mo ya si mimo fun O
Ki won kun fun iyin Re.
Gba ese mi ko si je
Kin won ma sare fun O.
Gba ete mi je ki won
Gba ogbon mi ko si lo
Gege bi o ba ti fe
Ki o tun je temi mo
Mo fi gbogbo re fun O
Ki nje Tire titi lae.    Amin.

hymns.title: Take my life, and let it be
verses: 1.Take my life, and let it be
Take my moments and my days;
Let them flow in ceaseless praise.
2.Take my hands, and let them move
At the impulse of Thy love
Take my feet, and let them be
3.Take my voice, and let me sing
Take my lips, and let them be
Not a mite would I withhold.
Every pow’r as Thou shalt choose.
5.Take my will, and make it Thine,
It shall be no longer mine.
Take my heart, it is Thine own;
It shall be Thy royal throne.
6.Take my love; my Lord, I pour
Take myself, and I will be
Ever, only, all for Thee!   Amen

hymns.title: Work for the night is coming,
verses: Work while the dew is sparkling,
Work, when the day grows brighter,
Work, for the night is coming,
Work, for the night is coming,
While their bright tints are glowing,
Work, till the last beam fedeth,
Work while the night is dark'ning,

hymns.title: Tire titi lae lawa se
chorus: Gbati aye ba ndun mo ni

hymns.title: Thine, Thine forever Blessed Bond
verses: That knit us, Lord to Thee
My voice and bean, and soul respond
May Thine for ever from the skies
Steal down and break the Charm.
May Thine for ever in our hearts
Amen, so let it be.  Amen
chorus: When this word strikes its dullest harp
Be "Thine for ever" clear and sharp

hymns.title: Emi atara ile wa
verses: Ngo f’ise won han n’iwa mi
Sibe n’nu se mi ki nsi ni
Emi ki yo pe tu ninu
Mo si fe je eni mimo
Ki nsi fa gbogbo ile mi
4.Jesu bo ba da na fe na
Ti o gba mi lowo egbe
Mo wa lati gba’le mi la

hymns.title: I and all those of my household
verses: 1.I and all those of my household
Wll worship and serve the Lord God,
By my words and by my actions
Show that I know the God of heav'n
From the way of my ward;
By my life, show them their duty
Yet, in my duty, to obtain
I also want to be holy
And bring my household and loved ones
4.When Thou has put the flame of love
Lord, do Thy good will within me,
Help to show by my life how each Bible
5.Grant to me, dear Lord, Thy good grace;
That sav'd my soul from perdition
And the grace that is felt within
Of which each tongue can speak.
6.I who have been set free from sin
Desire my household to be sav'd;
To my child, my wife and servants
To make them walk in the good way

hymns.title: Om'-ogun Jesu dide
verses: Ogun fe ni ja si le.
Fun awon  ti a sa ti

hymns.title: Soldiers of Jesus rise up
verses: And put on the whole armour
The great battle is at hand
2. Put up your spears, lift them up
And let your banner fly high
Raise it up, and march forward
That don’t hear the word of life
Lift up the lamp of the truth
Speak of the One who gives hope
Speak of One that saves in love
With the great pow’r of Jesus
7. Let your banner fly so high
Let the sword of the Lord shine
Till the kingdom of this world
Becomes the kingdom of God. Amen.

hymns.title: Je ki ilekun aitase,
verses: T'lo si, ti ki o ti mo.
Bi nwon siti ntan oro Re,
Ma je ki agbara Re pin;
Ti gbogbo ija o sitan. Amin.

hymns.title: O Let a great and stedfast door
verses: 1. O Let a great and stedfast door
Open up for our work, O Lord
That will open, and never shuts
The door to the light of your word
2. Touch their tongues with coals of fire
Which shows His way to the whole world
And place righteous love in their hearts
For the Lord and for all mankind
3. Give great passion to your servant
So that nothing can hinder him
As they are spreading out His word
Bless their thoughts and their endeavours
4. Send down your spirit from above
Don’t let your power come to end
Till all discomfort come to end
And all struggles and fightings end. Amen

hymns.title: Olorun awon woli sure fun
verses: Kin won ma po n’nu agbara Re si.
2. Yan won ni woli, si won ni eti
Si ohun orun si won ni aya
Si Iwasu mimo, si eti won
A!Pelu won kin won le so aiye di
4. Se won l’oba; oba awon oba
Kin won kede Re so won d’atunbi
Ti won kise Ade wura Faiye
Kin won kede Re ka gbogbo aiye
Mu won ka’ ogo aiye yis’ofo
Kin won gba ere Iye ailopin
6. Ojo awon Woli tun pada wa
Are nmu aiye, Ran ijoba Re. Amin

hymns.title: May God of the great prophets of old bless
verses: 1. May God of the great prophets of old bless
The prophets’  sons who follow after him
Sp’rit of Elijah comes on Elisha
That they might increase in His great power
2. Appoint them as prophets, open their ears
To the things of heaven, open their hearts
To the gospel of truth, open their ears
To destroy the devices of Satan
3. Appoint them prophets; to give sacrifice
For forgiveness, tender mercy and peace
O! be with them so they might change this world
To Holiness through Christ, Life eternal
4. Make them into royal kings, kings of kings
To pronounce Him, o make them born again
Theirs is not the golden crown for this world
Blood, sword, they use to proclaim salvation
5. Make them to be powerful apostle
Let them proclaim Him throughout the whole earth
Make them count this whole world’s glory as vain
And get the reward of eternal life
6. The days of the prophets return again
That the power of old should dwell live with us
Dear Lord Jesus, please come down to us here
The world is tired, send down your kingdom. Amen.

hymns.title: E ma kede oro mi lo
verses: 1. E ma kede oro mi lo
So t’esu na ti mbo wa

hymns.title: Keep on preaching my word to all
verses: 1. Keep on preaching my word to all
Let the world hear my goodness
He who accepets my word will live
He who rejects it will die
Think of how your end shall be
Think of how your end shall be
Rise up and and plead with God greatly

hymns.title: Lo kede ayo naa fun gbogbo aye
verses: 1.Lo kede ayo naa fun gbogbo aye
Sugbon awa ni Baba kan loke
T'O mo pe ’se Re ni wa
Gbat' a ba yo si O, Eleda wa
A tun f’ogo fun Omo Re
Awa tun f’ogo fun O Emi Mimo

hymns.title: Go, tell the good tidings to all people,
verses: 1.Go, tell the good tidings to all people,
That God the son has conquered death,
With joy and happiness relay the news
2.Angel sang songs of praises to Jesus
Who redeemed the people of work;
Jesus who was God and man
On earth and in heaven too.
4.Thick shame covered up all the wicked
Who nailed our Lord to the Cross,
All evil plans of foe were brought to nought
5.As African Nation of world we knew,
We were named as withering grass
But we have our Father Omnipotent God
Who made us and breathed in us.
we pray Thee Lord grant unto us
That when shall complete our task in this world
7. Glory to the Father, we do offer,
To Son and Holy Spirit, To,
chorus: Glory, Honour and power and majesty,
To the lamb of God Enthroned.

hymns.title: Asegun ati ajogun ni a je
verses: Nipa eje Kristi a ni isegun
B'Oluwa je tiwa, a ki yo subu
Ko sohun to le bori agbara Re
K’ise fun wa, sugbon Tire ni iyin
3.Enit’o ba si segun li ao fi fun
Lati je manna to t’orun wa nihin
L’orun y’o si gbe imo pe asegun
Yoo wo 'so funfun, yoo si dade wura.
chorus: Asegun ni wa, nipa eje Jesu
Baba fun wa ni segun, nipa eje Jesu

hymns.title: Conquerors and overcomers now are
verses: Thro' the precious blood of Christ we've victory
If the Lord be for us we can never fail,
Nothing 'gainst His mighty power can e'er prevail,
2.In the name of Israel's God we'll onward press,
Not to us but unto Him the praise shall be,
For salvation and for blood bought victory.
3.Unto Him that overcometh shall be given,
Here to eat of hidden manna sent from Heaven,
Over yonder He the victors palm shall bear,
And a robe of while, and golden crown shall wear.
chorus: Conquerors are we, thro' the blood of Jesus
God will give us victory, thro' the blood of Jesus
Through the Lamb for sinners slain,
Yet who lives and reigns again,

hymns.title: Eyin ero, nibo l’e nlo
verses: A nrin ajo mimo kan lo
Omi iye l’a o maa mu
A o ba Olorun wa gbe
A o ba Olorun wa gbe
A o ba Olorun wa gbe
Yoo maa so wa, yoo maa to wa
Yoo maa so wa, yoo maa to wa
Y’o maa so wa, y’o maa to wa
Wa maa kalo wa maa kalo
Wa, e mase fi wa sile

hymns.title: All ye people of the Lord
verses: Going each with staff in hand?
We are going on a journey,
Over hills and plains and valleys,
We are going to His palace,
We are going to His palace,
We are going to His palace,
2. Tell us, pilgrims, what you hope for
Spotless robes, and crowns of glory,
We shall drink of life's clear river,
We shall dwell with God for ever,
We shall dwell with God for ever,
In that bright, that better land,
We shall dwell with God for ever,
In that bright, that better land
3. Doth ye not fear the way ye trod
The Friend unseen goeth with us
Jesus Christ our Lord doth guide us,
He shall watch us, He shall lead us,
He shall watch us, He shall lead us,
He shall watch us, He shall lead us,
4. Pilgrims, may we travel with you
To that bright and better land?
Come and welcome, come and welcome
Come, oh, come! and do not leave us;
Christ is waiting to receive us,
Christ is waiting to receive us,
In that bright, that better land,
Christ is waiting to receive us,
In that bright, that better land

hymns.title: Alejo kan ma nkankun
verses: O ti pe t'O ti npaara
Pe wole ki O to lo
Yo pa o mo de opin

hymns.title: There's a Stranger at the door,
verses: He has been there oft before,
Let Him in, ere is gone,
Let Him in, the Holy One,
If you wait He will depart;
Let Him in, He is your Friend,
He your soul will sure defend,
He will keep you to the end,
Now, oh now make Him your choice,
He is standing at your door,
Joy to you He will restore,
And His name you will adore,
He will make for you a feast,
He will speak your sins forgiven,
And when earth ties all are riven,
He will take you home to heaven, .

hymns.title: Kii se l’aini ’reti
verses: O mo bi mo ti ri

hymns.title: No, not despairingly
verses: Yet is this still my plea:
Yet is this still my plea;
All I am tell I Thee
Wash Thou my soul this day;
Wash Thou my soul this day;
Blood of the Lamb of God,
Blood of the Lamb of God,
Thus shall I walk with Thee

hymns.title: Jesu y’o gba elese
verses: O ti so mi di mimo
chorus: Ko lorin, ko si tun ko
Fi oto na ye won pe

hymns.title: Sinners Jesus will receive;
verses: Sound this word of grace to all
All who linger, all who fall!
Sing it o'er and o'er again,
2.Come and He will give you rest;
Trust him for His word is plain;
Pure before the law I stand;
He who cleansed me from all spot
Even me with all my sin;
Purged from every spot and stain,
Heaven with Him I enter in.
chorus: Sing it o'er and o'er again,
Make the message clear and plain;

hymns.title: Ma sise lo, mase sare
verses: Ko ha ye kawa ko se be.
Ko ba le gba okan re la.
Gbe ina gbagbo re ma fi
Y’o ke tantan pe, "Emi de".   Amin.

hymns.title: Go, labour on; spend, and be spent,
verses: 1.Go, labour on; spend, and be spent,
Thy joy to do the Father's will
It is the way the Master went;
Should not the servant tread it still?
2.Go labor on, while it is day;
The world’s dark night is hastening on:
Speed, speed thy work, cast sloth away;
It is not thus that souls are won.
3.Men die in darkness at your side,
Without a hope to cheer the tomb;
Take up the torch, and wave it wide,
The torch that lights time's thickest gloom.
4.Toil on, and in thy toil rejoice;
For toil comes rest, for exile home;
Soon shall thou hear the Bridegroom's voice,
The midnight peal, Behold, I come!

hymns.title: Gbat' o ba de, gba t’o ba de
verses: 1.Gbat' o ba de, gba t’o ba de

hymns.title: When He cometh, when He cometh
verses: 2. He will gather, He will gather
All the pure ones, all the bright ones,
chorus: Like the stars of the morning.
They shall shine in their beauty

hymns.title: 'Gbat’aye yi ba koja
verses: Ti orun Re ba si wo
Bi gbese mi ti po to
’Gba nba ri O b’o ti ri
Ti mo fe’O la fe tan
Bi gbese mi ti po to.
Bi gbese mi ti po to.
Bi gbese mi ti po to.
Bi gbese mi ti po to.
Ko mi ki nfi han l’aye
Bi gbese mi ti po to.
Ko mi ki nfi han l’aye
Bi gbese mi ti po to.

hymns.title: When this passing world is done,
verses: When has sunk yon glaring sun,
When we stand with Christ on high,
Then, Lord, shall I fully know,
Not till then, how much I owe.
Then, Lord, shall I fully know,
Not till then, how much I owe.
Dress'd in beauty not my owns
When I see Thee as Thou art,
Then, Lord, shall I fidly know,
Not till then, how much I owe.
Then, Lord, shall I fidly know,
Not till then, how much I owe.
3.When the praise of heav'n I hear,
Loud as thunders to the ear,
Then, Lord, shall I fully know,
Not till then, how much I owe.
Then, Lord, shall I fully know,
Not till then, how much I owe.
4.Ev'n on earth, as though a glass,
Wake Thy Spirit's help so meet;
Ev'n on earth,Lord, make me know
Something of how much I owe.
Ev'n on earth,Lord, make me know
Something of how much I owe.
Waken'd up from wrath to flee,
Teach me, Lord, on earth to show,
By my love, how much I owe.
Teach me, Lord, on earth to show,
By my love, how much I owe.

hymns.title: Igba mi mbe li owo Re
verses: Baba ki y’o je k'omo Re
Lem’ o wa titi lai. Amin.

hymns.title: My times are in Thy hand,
verses: My God, I wish them there;
My life, my friends, my soul I leave
Pleasing or painful, dark or bright,
As best may seem to Thee.
Why should I doubt or fear?
A Father's hand will never cause
The hand my cruel sins had pierced
Is now my guard and guide.
And after death at Thy right hand

hymns.title: Olugbala, joo sokale
verses: Bee ni emi ki yoo si mo.
Ma ri ibi gbe l’okan mi
See mi ni Tire, et ore ni
Ti aye yi le fi fun ni
Kristi nikan ni y’o maa sin.
Pe, iwo gba mi ni Tire.
Ju k’ife Re wa l’aya mi
Mo ko ohun gbogb’ yooku. Amin.

hymns.title: O Saviour Christ, come down to me
verses: 1.O Saviour Christ, come down to me
Help me, O Lord, with grace divine
Oh expel the love of the world
In me, prepare a place for Thee
And make me free, yes, free indeed
I long not after other things
Except Thee, Lord both day and night.
3.As long as I am here on earth
I desire no other good thing
I will bid farewell to the world
4.The way that my blest Saviour trod
With all haste I will seek and find
Neither will my heart crave to know
Any love, but my Saviour's love.
Of life have a place in my heart
Make it all Thine for it's Thine own
It is Thy plan, my heart to rule,
Other things this world can afford
Christ only will my heart worship
7.Thou, only Thou I choose to love
From the very depths of my heart
That Thou accepts me as Thine own.
8.There's naught I desire or long for
But that Thy love take possession
This, only this, my earnest plea
All other things I count as dung. Amen.

hymns.title: Jerusalem ijo mimo
verses: Besu gbe ogun re si wa
Aye ko le ri wa gbe se
Esu ko le ri wa gbe se
Ina esu ko le jo wa

hymns.title: Jerusalem, a holy church
verses: If the devil charge against us
Devil will bow down at his feet
As long as Jesus is with us
Keep on praying our strong leader
Great mountains will turn to valleys
The whole world will not do us harm
Lift the victorious sword high up
What is it that you’re afraid of
The devil will not do us harm
Get ready to sing joyous songs
Let us sing unto our great King
Hail aloud to God of Daniel
If death strikes down from right and left
Fire of Satan could not harm them
Glory to the His Son above
By the power of the Creator

hymns.title: Isimi wa l’orun ko si l’aye yi
verses: 1.Isimi wa l’orun ko si l’aye yi
Emi o se kun, gbati'yonu ba de
Simi okan mi, eyikeyi to de
O din ajo mi ku, o mu kile ya.
2.Ko to fun mi, ki nma simi nihin yi
Ki nsi ma kole mi ninu aye yi
Ongbe ilu t’a ko f’owo ko ngbe mi
Mo nreti aye ti ese ko baje.
3.Egun esusu le ma hu yi mi ka
Sugbon emi ko ni gbarale aye
Emi ko wa ’simi kan ni aye
Tit' emi o fi simi laya Jesu mi.
4.'Yonu le damu, sugbon ko le pa mi
Oju fe Jesu le so yonu derin
Erin Re le so ekun wa di ayo
Bigba t’efufu fe ojo sisu lo. Amin.

hymns.title: There is rest in heaven, not on this earth
verses: 1. There is rest in heaven, not on this earth
Why should I murmur, when troubles come to me
Be at peace, oh my soul, whatever shall come
These reduce my stay here, and take me home soon
2. It's not enough for me, to be resting here
That I should build my resting place in this world
I thirst for the great city built without hands
I hope for a world not corrupted by sin
3. Terrible thorns may be growing around me
But I will never put my trust in the world
I do not seek a resting place in this world
Till I rest upon the bossom of my Jesus
4. Troubles may shake me, but it will not kill me
The love of Jesus can make my pain pleasant
Your smile can transform our mourning into joy
Just like the strong wild wind blows away the cloud.   Amen.

hymns.title: Ojo ayo lojo oni
verses: Eyin Angel e ba wa yo
O ti siju anu wo wa
Ko si je k’awon ota yo wa
Jeje lo nto wa lona Re
O si gba wa lowo ota wa
Fun abo Re lori gbogbo wa
chorus: Ogun orun e, ba wa yo
E ba wa yo, ayo oni

hymns.title: A day of joy, Thanks-giving day
verses: 1. A day of joy, Thanks-giving day
All ye Angels here rejoice with us
For this great joy, God sent to us,
2.Our souls give praises to the King,
Our hearts rejoice to our Father God
For great mercy bestow on us
Lest enemies  could   have mocked at us.
Chorus:Ye heavenly Host rejoice with us
All ye who dwell face to face with God
The Sun, the Moon, Come worship Him,
And all the world, come and hallowed Him.
Chorus: Ye heavenly Host rejoice with us
4.His strength He has shown to the World
As He has shown to our fore¬fathers
He lead us quietly to Him
And save us from all our enemies.
Chorus: Ye heavenly Host rejoice with us
5. The strong He overthroned for us
And on his throne, He has raised the meek,
Who shall we praise like unto Thee
Praise Him, praise Him, all the world praise Him
Chorus: Ye heavenly Host rejoice with us
6.We thank Thee Oh our Father God
For Thy mercy on The Seraphim
Praise Him, praise Him all His creatures
All ye Heavens hallow ye Jesus.
Chorus: Ye heavenly Host rejoice with us
chorus: Ye heavenly Host rejoice with us
Raise up your voices ye Jerusalem
Rejoice with us, Rejoice with us

hymns.title: Jesu l’Olus'agutan mi,
verses: Ko s’ ewu bi mo je Tire,
T’ On sije t’ emi titi.
Nibe l’ o nm’ okan mi lo;
L’ O nf’ onje orun bo mi.
3. Mo ti fi were sako lo,
N’ ife, O si wa mi ri;
L’ ejika Re l’ O gbe mi si,
O f’ ayo mu mi wa ‘le.
B’ Iwo ba wa lodo mi;
Awon l’ o ntu mi ninu.
A! ayo na ha ti po to!
Ti nt’ odo Re wa ba mi.
Ore Re ki y’o ye lai;

hymns.title: The King of love my shepherd is,
verses: 1. The King of love my shepherd is,
I nothing lack if I am his,
2. Where streams of living water flow,
and where the verdant pastures grow,
3. Perverse and foolish, oft I strayed,
but yet in love he sought me;
and on his shoulder gently laid,
4. In death's dark vale I fear no ill,
with thee, dear Lord, beside me;
thy rod and staff my comfort still,
thy cross before to guide me.
5. Thou spreadst a table in my sight;
and oh, what transport of delight
6. And so through all the length of days,
Good Shepherd, may I sing thy praise

hymns.title: Awon to gbekele Oluwa,
verses: Oore Ofe Mi to fun o
T’eru npa t’o si nwa isinmi
Oore ofe Mi to fun o
Bi aare tile mu o subu
Oore ofe Mi to fun o
At’ewu ko le ba mi l’eru
Tori mo di ileri yi mu
Oore ofe Mi to fun o.
chorus: Oore Ofe Mi to fun o
Oore Ofe Mi to fun o
Oore Ofe Mi to fun o

hymns.title: They that trust in the Lord are secure,
verses: 1.They that trust in the Lord are secure
Tho’ storm ranges dark o’er the sea
For this anchor of promise is sure
My grace is sufficient for thee
2.What a boon to the pilgrim opp rest
What a balm such a promise must be
To the laden ones seeking for rest
My grace is sufficient for thee
3.In the race for the price, fainting soul
Though a weary you bow down the knee
Rise again, and press on to the goal
My grace is sufficient for thee
4.Neither trial nor doubt brings die may
Nor from danger that comes will I flee
For I stand on this promise today
My grace is sufficient for thee.
chorus: My grace is sufficient for thee
My grace is sufficient for thee
Oh, matchless, boundless grace of God
My grace is sufficient for thee

hymns.title: Ninu irin ajo mi, beeni mo nkorin
verses: 1.Ninu irin ajo mi, beeni mo nkorin
Mo n toka si kalfari, s’ibi eje naa
Idanwo lode ninu, l’ota gbe dide
Jesu lo nto mi lo, isegun daju
2.Ninu ise isin mi, b’okunkun ba su
N o tunbo sunmo Jesu, y’o tan imole
Esu le gb’ogun ti mi, kin le sa pada
Jesu lo nto mi lo, ko se’wu fun mi
Imole itoni Re, yoo mole si mi
Yoo na owo re si mi, yoo gbe mi soke
N o maa tesiwaju, b’o ti nto mi lo
4.Nigba ti iji aye yi ba yi lu mi
Mo ni abo t’o daju, labe apa Re
Y’o maa f’owo Re to mi titi de opin
Ore ododo ni, A! mo ti f’e to.
chorus: A! mo fe ri Jesu kin maa w’oju Re
Ki nma korin titi nipa oore Re
Ni ilu ogo ni ki ngbohun soke
Pe mo bo, ija tan, mo de ile mi.

hymns.title: Spirit of mercy, truth, and love,
verses: 1.As I journey through the land, singing as I go
Pointing souls to calvary – to the crimson flow
Many arrows pierce my soul from without, within
But my Lord leads me on, thro’ Him, I must win.
2.‘When in service for my Lord dark may be the Night
But I’ll cling more close to Him, He wil give me light
Satan’s snare may vex my soul turn my thoughts aside
But my Lord goes ahead, leads whate’er betide
3.When in valleys lowi look toward the mountain height
And behold my savour there leading in the fight
With a tender hand outstretched towards the valley low
Guiding me, I can see, as I onward go
4.When before me billows rise from the mighty deep
Then my Lord direct my back; He doth safely keep
And He leads me gently on thro’ this world below
He’s a real friend to me, O I love Him so. Amen.
chorus: Oh I want to see Him, look upon His face
There to sing forever, of His saving grace
On the streets of glory let me lift my voice
Cares all past, home at last, ever to rejoice

hymns.title: Mo nte siwaju lona naa
verses: Mo ngbadura bi mo ti lo
3.Mo fe ki nga ju aye lo
B’esu ti le ngbogun ti mi
Mo nfi gbagbo gbo orin naa
Mo ngbadura ki n le de be
Laisi re nko le de’ be
Fa mi ki n fi d’oke orun
chorus: Apata to ga ju mi lo

hymns.title: I’m pressing on the upward way;
verses: Still praying as I onward bound
Lord plant my feet on higher ground
2.My heart has no desire to stay
Where doubts arise and fears dismay
Though some may dwell where tis abound
My prayer, my aim is higher ground
3.I want to live above the world
Though Satan darts at me are hurled
For faith has caught the joyful sound
The song of saints on higher ground
4.I want to scale the utmost height
And catch a gleam of glory bright
But still I’ll pray till rest I’ve found
Lord, lead me on to higher ground
5.Lord lift me to the upward way
I cannot get there without Thee
Lord, lead me to the Heav’nly found
And sing my song from Higher ground.
chorus: Lord, lift me up and let me stand
By faith on canaan table land;
A higher plane than I have found;
Lord, plant my feet on higher ground

hymns.title: Ekun ko le gba mi
verses: Ko le mu eru mi tan
Ko le we ese mi nu
Bi mo ba duro, n o ku
Je ki n gbekele omo Re
Je ki nsa si apa Re
chorus: Jesu sun, o ku fun mi
On na lo le gba mi

hymns.title: Weeping wil not save me!
verses: Though my face were bathed in tears
That could not allay my fears
Could not wash the sins of years
Purest deeds that I can do
Cannot form my soul a new
In my ears is mercy’s cry
If I wait I can but die
Faith in Christ will save me
Let me trust thy weeping son
Trust the work that He has done
To His arms, Lord, help me run
Faith in Christ will save me,
chorus: Jesus wept and died for me
Jesus waits to make me free

hymns.title: Ogo ni f’oluwa to se ohun nla
verses: 1.Ogo ni f’oluwa to se ohun nla
Ife lo mu k’o fun wa ni omo Re
Enit’o f’emi re lele f’ese wa
To si silekun iye sile fun wa.
F’enikeni t’o gba ileri re gbo
Enit’o buruju b’o ba le gbagbo
Loju kanna y’o ri idariji gba
3.O s’ohun nla fun wa, o da wa l’ola
Ayo wa di kikun ninu omo Re
Yo ya wa lenu ‘gbat’a ba ri Jesu
chorus: Ka to Baba wa lo l’oruko Jesu
Je k’a jo f’ogo fun onise ‘yanu

hymns.title: To God be the glory, great things he has done
verses: 1.To God be the glory, great things he has done
So loved he the world that he gave us His son
Who yielded his life an atonement for sin
And opened the life gate that all may go in
2.O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood
To every believer the promise of God
The vilest offender who truly believes
The moment from Jesus a pardon receives
3.Great things he that taught us, great things he hath done
And great our rejoicing through Jesus the son
But purer, and higher and greater will be
Our wonder, our transport when Jesus we see.
chorus: Praise the Lord, Praise the Lord
Let the earth hear His voice
Praise the Lord, Praise the Lord
O come, to the father, through Jesus the Son
And give Him the glory, great things He hath done

hymns.title: Bo ti dun lati gba Jesu gbo
verses: 1.Bo ti dun lati gba Jesu gbo
Igbagbo ni ki a fi bo
4.Mo yo mo gb’eke mi le o
Mo mo pe o wa pelu mi

hymns.title: lts so sweet to trust in Jesus
verses: 1.Its so sweet to trust in Jesus
Just to take Him at His word
Just to rest upon His promise
Just to know “Thus saith the Lord”
2.O how sweet to trust in Jesus
Just to trust his cleansing blood
Just in simple faith to plunge me
Just from sin and self to cease
Life and rest and joy and peace.
4.I’m so glad I learned to trust Thee
And I know that thou art with me
Will be with me to the end.
chorus: Jesus, Jesus, how I trust Him!
How I’ve proved him o’er and o’er
O for grace to trust Him more

hymns.title: Eyin t’efe Oluwa
verses: Ki a to de gbangba orun (2ce)
chorus: A n yan lo si sion
A n yan goke lo si sion

hymns.title: Come ye that love the Lord
verses: Come ye that love the Lord
And let your joys be known
Join in a song with sweet accord (2ce)
But children of the heavenly king (2ce)
Before we reach the heav’nly fields (2ce)

hymns.title: Ayo b’aye! Oluwa de
verses: Won ngbe, won ngberin ayo naa

hymns.title: Joy to the world! The Lord is come
verses: 1.Joy to the world! The Lord is come
Let every heart prepare Him room
2.Joy to the earth! The savior reigns
While fields and floods, rocks, hills and plain
3.No more let sins and sorrows grow
He comes to make His blessings flow
Far as the curse is found (2ce)
Far as far as the curse is found.
4.He rules the world with truth and grace
And wonders, and wonders of His love. Amen.

hymns.title: Eyin angel’ l’orun ogo
verses: A o ko gbogb’ aye s’odo ‘Re
Gbogb’ eekun yoo wole fun un. Amin.

hymns.title: Angels from the realms of glory
verses: Wing your flight o’er all the earth
Watching o’er your flocks by night
God with man is now residing
Seek the great desire of nations
Watching long with hope and fear
To th’ Eternal Three in one.
chorus: Worship Christ the new born King

hymns.title: Mo nduro lori ileri krist’ oba
verses: Eni ti a o maa yin titi laelae
Ogo f’olorun, emi yoo maa korin
2.Mo nduro le ileri ti ko le ye
Gba ti iyemeji at’eru ba de
Nipa oro Re li emi yoo segun
3.Ileri re la mi loju lati ri
Ife lo fi so mi po mo ara Re
Nipa oro Re mo nsegun lojoojo
chorus: Mo nduro lori ileri Oluwa Mi

hymns.title: Standing on the promises of Christ thy King
verses: 1.Standing on the promises of Christ thy King
Thro’ eternal ages let His praises ring
Glory in the Highest, I will shout and sing
Standing on the Promises of God.
2.Standing on the promises that cannot fail
When the howling storms of doubt and fear assail
By the wing word of God I shall prevail
Standing on the promises of God
3.Standing on the promises I can now see
Prefect, present cleansing in the blood for me
Standing on the liberty where Christ makes free
Standing on the promises of God
4.Standing on the promises of Christ the Lord
Bound to Him eternally by love strong cord
Overcoming daily with the spirit’s sword
Standing on the promises of God.
chorus: Standing on the promises of God my savior
I am Standing on the promises of God

hymns.title: Okan mi sipaya, Oluwa
verses: Dide Re mu mi sunmo o si
3.Mo da o duro s’ode pe ju
Nko ni da o duro s’ode mo
chorus: Maa ba mi gbe titi Oluwa,
Ohun ti o fe ni n o fe,
Fi okan mi se ‘bugbe Re laelae

hymns.title: My heart is open to thee dear Lord,
verses: 1.My heart is open to thee dear Lord,
My faith is clinging to thy dear word
2.Yes, there is room in my heart, dear Lord
Thy presence makes Heaven real to me
3.I kept thee standing outside so long
I pray thee pardon this shameful wrong
4.I hear thee knocking at my hearts door
I’ll keep thee waiting outside no more
chorus: Come not to tarry, but stay dear Lord
All shall be thine love can afford,
Here in my heart ever make thine abode

hymns.title: Mo ti ni Jesu l‘ore, O j‘ohun gbogbo fun mi
verses: 1.Mo ti ni Jesu l‘ore, O j‘ohun gbogbo fun mi;
Oun nikan l‘Arewa ti okan mi fe,
Oun n‘itanna ipado, Oun ni Enikan na
T‘O le we mi nu kuro n‘nu ese mi
Olutunu mi l‘O je n‘nu gbogbo wahala
Oun ni ki n k‘aniyan mi l‘Oun lori,
Oun ni Itanna Ipado, Irawo owuro,
Oun nikan l‘Arewa ti okan mi fe
‘Tori Re mo k‘ohun gbogbo ti mo ti fe sile,
O si f'agbara Re gbe okan mi ro;
Bi aye tile ko mi, ti Satan’dan mi wo,
Jesu yoo mu mi d‘opin irin mi;
Oun ni itanna ipado, irawo owuro,
Oun nikan l‘Arewa ti okan mi fe.
3.Oun ki yoo fi mi sile, be ki yoo ko mi nihin,
Niwon ti nba fi ‘gbagbo p‘ofin Re mo;
O j‘odi ‘na yi mi ka, n ki yoo berukeru,
Yoo fi manna Re b‘okan mi t‘ebi n pa,
‘Gba nba d‘ade n‘ikeyin, n o r‘oju ‘bukun Re,
Ti adun Re yoo maa san titi lae lae,
Oun ni Itanna Ipado, irawo owuro,
Oun nikan l‘Arewa ti okan mi fe .

hymns.title: I’ve found a friend in Jesus
verses: He’s the fairest of ten thousand to my soul!
The “Lily of the Valley,” in Him alone I see
All I need to cleanse and make me fully whole:
He tells me every care on Him to roll,
He’s the fairest of ten thousand to my soul!
In temptation He’s my strong and mighty tower;
I’ve all for Him forsaken, I’ve all my idols torn
He keeps me by His power.
Though all the world forsake me,
Through Jesus I shall safely reach the goal.
He’s the fairest of ten thousand to my soul!
While I live by faith, and do His blessed will;
A wall of fire about me,
With His manna He my hungry soul shall fill,
When crowned at last in glory,
Where rivers of delight shall ever roll;
He’s the lilly of the valley,
He’s the fairest of ten thousand to my soul

hymns.title: Alleluya! Orin t’o dun
verses: Nile ti Olorun mi n gbe,
Gbat’ a wa laye osi yi,

hymns.title: Alleluia, song of sweetness
verses: Voice of joy that cannot die;
Ever raised by choirs on high;
In the house of God abiding
Thou Mayest Lift the Joyful Strain,
Faint And Feeble Are Our Praises
Be our song while here below;
Make us for a while forgo;
For the solemn time is coming
When our tears for sin must flow.
4.Therefore, in our hymns we pray thee,
At the last to keep thine Easter,
In our home beyond the sky,
There to thee for ever singing

hymns.title: Gbati o ba nlo s'ile 'simi orun
verses: 'Tori Oun ni Oluto t'O m'ona ju,
O dara lati ri ojurere Re,
3.Ki o ba le bo lowo ofa esu,
Nibi ti a ki wi pe “odigbose”
chorus: Fara mo Jesu, Fara mo Jesu,
Losan tabi l'oru mase ya kuro,

hymns.title: When you start for the land of heavenly rest
verses: 1.When you start for the land of heavenly rest,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
For He is the Guide, and He knows the way best,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.
2.Never mind the storms of trials as you go,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
’Tis a comfort and joy His favour to know,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.
3.To be safe from the darts of the evil one,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
Take the shield of faith till the victory is won,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.
4.We shall reach our home in Heaven by & by,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
Where to those we love we’ll never say goodbye,
Keep close to Jesus all the way. Amin.
chorus: Keep close to Jesus, keep close to Jesus,
Keep close to Jesus all the way;
By day or by night never turn from the right,
Keep close to Jesus all the way.
